Four kitchens share one floor (Japanese/kaiseki, teppanyaki, tempura, sushi) and each has its own list.

items.en: Japanese breakfast set — small dish, simmered dish, grilled fish, toasted nori, pickles, miso soup, rice, and yoghurt with fruit. Served 7:00–10:30, last entry 10:00
items.section: 和食ダイニング 朝食 Breakfast (7:00–10:30)
items.note: 焼肴 and 焚合 are simmered/glazed in soy; the nori is normally 味付け (soy-seasoned). Fish and dairy.

items.en: Kyoto-style morning rice porridge — small dish, simmered dish, grilled fish, pickles, miso soup, plain white congee with a Yoshino-kudzu bekko sauce, sardines, and yoghurt with fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 朝食 Breakfast (7:00–10:30)
items.note: The congee itself is rice and water and the 吉野葛 thickener is kudzu starch, not wheat — but the べっこあん is a soy-seasoned sauce and the 焼肴 is glazed. Ask for the congee plain.

items.ja: 熊魚菴ランチ御膳「古都」
items.en: Koto lunch set — today's small dish, two sashimi, seasonal tempura assortment, fresh yuba with salmon roe, salmon-and-edamame rice, Kyoto Yamari red miso soup, pickles
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 天ぷら is wheat batter and the sashimi comes with soy. Add-ons: coffee/tea +¥500, three seasonal fruits +¥850, chawanmushi +¥1,000, grilled fish +¥1,800, wagyu fillet steak +¥5,000, salt-grilled Lake Biwa baby ayu (2) +¥2,000, conger steamed in yuba +¥1,500, matsutake-and-hamo dobin-mushi +¥3,500.

items.en: Hamo hari-hari hotpot set — seasonal appetiser, pike conger in nanban marinade, two sashimi, salt-grilled greenling, then the pot itself: hamo rolled in yuba with mizuna, sasa-negi, tofu, carrot, daikon and shiitake. Rice, miso, pickles. Summer only, 1 June–31 Aug
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 南蛮漬け and the hotpot broth are both soy-based; 湯葉 itself is fine but everything it sits in is not. Hamo (pike conger) is the Kyoto summer fish — worth ordering if you have never had it.

items.ja: 熊魚菴季節のおまかせランチ「彩」
items.en: Sai omakase lunch — seven-part appetiser (fig in sesame vinegar, bayberry in syrup, Yoshino-style shrimp, vegetable omelette, sweet potato, okra-and-smoked-duck skewer, corn shinjo), matsutake and fish-dumpling clear soup with junsai, thin-sliced sea bream, salt-grilled greenling, hamo yanagawa hotpot, salmon-edamame rice, red miso, three pickles, fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 擬製玉子 is egg; 真蒸 (shinjo) fish dumplings are bound with starch and often wheat; yanagawa is a soy-and-egg simmer. Dashi throughout.

items.ja: 熊魚菴ランチ贅沢コース「洛」
items.en: Raku luxury lunch — the same seven appetisers, then the house-signature suppon (soft-shell turtle) hotpot with tofu, grilled mochi and negi; sea bream, bluefin and surf clam sashimi; tempura of a wild tiger prawn with three seasonal vegetables; Kyoto beef roast beef; salmon-edamame rice, red miso, pickles, melon and fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 昼食 Lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Tempura is wheat. 焼餅 is glutinous rice, which despite the English name contains no gluten — but it sits in a soy broth.

items.en: Summer eel mini kaiseki, served in four passes — sesame tofu and unagi-zaku; eel chawanmushi; a two-tier box of two sashimi over a whole grilled eel kabayaki with three pickles; liver clear soup; dessert. Lunch and dinner, 1–31 August only
items.section: 和食ダイニング 季節限定 Seasonal (Aug 2026)
items.note: 蒲焼 glaze is soy and mirin — wheat. And the shop's own English says the soup contains WHEAT GLUTEN: 巻麩 is 麩, pure gluten. Two separate hard nos in one course.

items.en: Kyotoryoen — a summer-only course with a choice of main and two hours of free-flow drinks (draft and bottled beer, sake, red and white wine, sweet-potato and barley shochu, whisky, lemon sour, plum wine, soft drinks). 1 July–31 Aug
items.price: ¥13,000（＋¥2,000 to upgrade to champagne and premium sake）
items.section: 和食ダイニング 季節限定 Seasonal (Aug 2026)
items.note: The free-flow list explicitly includes beer and 麦焼酎 — barley in both. If you need gluten-free, the sake and the sweet-potato shochu in the same plan are the safe halves.

items.ja: 熊魚菴ディナー御膳「京」
items.en: Kyo dinner set — sesame tofu to start, two of today's sashimi, the house-famous silver cod grilled in Saikyo miso, chawanmushi, rice, miso and pickles
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: 銀鱈西京焼き is cod marinated in Saikyo sweet white miso — the miso's grain base is not declared, and the marinade normally carries mirin and sake. Chawanmushi's dashi is bonito. Same add-on list as the Koto lunch.

items.ja: ディナーステーキ御膳「雅」
items.en: Miyabi steak dinner set — sesame tofu, three sashimi, domestic beef fillet steak, fresh yuba with salmon roe, chawanmushi, salmon-edamame rice
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: The steak is the one component with no built-in wheat; the sauce is the question. Everything around it uses soy.

items.en: Akari kaiseki — the seven appetisers, kudzu-dusted hamo with matsutake and junsai in clear soup, sea bream/bluefin/surf clam sashimi, salt-grilled Lake Biwa ayu, simmered winter melon with grilled chicken, and on through rice, red miso, three pickles and fruit
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: 鱧葛打ち is dusted with kudzu starch (not wheat) before poaching — a genuinely wheat-free technique — but the dashi and the accompanying soy defeat it.

items.en: Suppon kaiseki — the house speciality, soft-shell turtle in six forms: two seasonal appetisers, the signature suppon hotpot, three sashimi, suppon chawanmushi with lily bulb and shiitake, suppon tempura with seasonal vegetables and tentsuyu, then suppon zosui rice porridge. Ten portions a day; book at least three days ahead
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: Tempura batter is wheat and 天だし is soy-based dashi. Turtle is prized in Japan as 滋養強壮 — a restorative.

items.en: Nagomi kaiseki — the full kaiseki with a main course you choose
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)

items.ja: 料理長おすすめ鱧と松茸の会席「禅」
items.en: Zen — the head chef's hamo-and-matsutake kaiseki, built around a matsutake dobin-mushi with pike conger and mitsuba
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)
items.note: Hamo and matsutake together is the definitive Kyoto late-summer pairing.

items.ja: 京都牛、すっぽん鍋、伊勢海老の贅沢会席「桂」
items.en: Katsura — the top kaiseki: Kyoto beef, the suppon hotpot and spiny lobster
items.section: 和食ダイニング 夕食 Dinner (17:00–22:00, L.O. 21:00)

items.en: Children's menu Hina — small dish, a children's plate of tuna sashimi, fried chicken, salmon roe and tamagoyaki with two simmered vegetables, rice, miso soup, seasonal ice cream
items.note: 若鶏の唐揚げ is wheat-floured and deep-fried.

items.en: Children's menu Mutsumi — small dish, appetiser assortment, two sashimi, fried prawn, five pieces of nigiri, miso soup, seasonal ice cream
items.note: 海老フライ is panko-breaded.

items.en: Sesame tofu — ground sesame set with kudzu starch, not soy; dense and faintly sweet
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: Sesame and kudzu only in the block itself — no wheat and no animal product — but it is served under a dab of wasabi and a soy-based sauce. Ask for it plain and it becomes one of the few genuinely safe plates here.

items.en: Yuba sashimi — the skin lifted off simmering soy milk, eaten raw
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: Soy milk and nothing else — the yuba itself is wheat-free and plant-based. It is dipped in soy sauce, which is not. Ask for salt instead.

items.en: Karasumi — salted, pressed and sun-dried grey mullet roe, sliced thin
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: One of Japan's three great 珍味 delicacies.

items.en: Konowata — salted fermented sea-cucumber entrails
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers
items.note: Another of the three great delicacies; intensely saline. Fish sauce and soy sometimes go into the cure.

items.en: Sea bream shiokara — the fish salted and fermented in its own guts
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers

items.en: Three delicacies on one plate
items.section: 逸品メニュー 先付 À la carte appetisers

items.en: Medium-fatty tuna, five pieces
items.section: 逸品メニュー お造り À la carte sashimi
items.note: The fish is clean; the soy sauce is the wheat.

items.en: Sashimi assortment, three kinds
items.section: 逸品メニュー お造り À la carte sashimi
items.note: Ask for salt or ponzu-free citrus if you avoid wheat — plain 醤油 is wheat by default in Japan.

items.en: Sashimi assortment, five kinds
items.section: 逸品メニュー お造り À la carte sashimi

items.en: Silver cod marinated in miso and grilled — the house signature
items.section: 逸品メニュー 焼物 À la carte grilled
items.note: Saikyo miso marinade with sake and mirin; miso grain base undeclared. Treat as wheat.

items.en: Pomfret in miso, grilled
items.section: 逸品メニュー 焼物 À la carte grilled
items.note: Same marinade.

items.en: Nama-fu dengaku — fresh wheat-gluten cake grilled and topped with sweet miso
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: 麩 IS wheat gluten — this dish is literally made of it. The restaurant's own English calls it 'fresh gluten'. Never order this gluten-free; it is, however, a plant food and a Kyoto classic.

items.en: Chawanmushi — savoury steamed egg custard
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: The custard is egg and dashi, and the dashi is seasoned with 薄口醤油 — light soy sauce, which is still wheat. Bonito, so not vegan.

items.en: Clear soup with a poached fish dumpling
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: 真蒸 are bound with yamaimo and often wheat starch, and the broth is soy-seasoned dashi.

items.en: Simmered sea bream head and collar
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: Simmered in soy and mirin.

items.en: Simmered seasonal vegetables
items.section: 逸品メニュー 温物 À la carte warm dishes
items.note: 炊き合わせ is simmered in bonito dashi with soy — plant ingredients, but neither wheat-free nor vegan.

items.en: Maru-nabe — the soft-shell turtle hotpot on its own, the dish the house is known for
items.section: 熊魚菴名物料理 House specialities
items.note: Broth is turtle stock with sake; ask whether soy goes in. Follow it with the zosui.

items.en: Suppon zosui — rice cooked in what is left of the turtle pot, finished with egg and scallion
items.section: 熊魚菴名物料理 House specialities
items.note: Egg; the pot's seasoning carries over.

items.en: Kyoto white miso soup — the sweet, pale, thickly textured Kyoto style
items.section: 熊魚菴名物料理 House specialities
items.note: Kyoto 白味噌 is a rice-koji miso, so usually wheat-free — but ask, and the dashi is bonito.

items.en: Kamo-manju — a dumpling of minced duck under a clear dashi sauce
items.section: 熊魚菴名物料理 House specialities
items.note: 饅頭 here means a steamed dumpling; the wrap and the ankake sauce are starch-thickened and soy-seasoned.

items.en: A5 Yonezawa beef, lean cut, 100g, from the grill

items.ja: 神戸牛サーロインステーキ 120g
items.en: Kobe beef sirloin steak, 120g — the most expensive single item on the list
Grilled Japanese spiny lobster, half
Grilled abalone steak
items.note: Abalone is usually finished with butter and soy on a teppan.

items.en: Tempura assortment with kuruma prawn
items.note: Wheat batter, wheat-soy tentsuyu, shared fryer — all three.

items.en: Vegetable tempura
items.note: Batter is wheat flour and egg; the dipping broth is bonito and soy.

items.en: Assorted nigiri, five pieces
items.section: 寿司 Sushi à la carte
items.note: The rice is seasoned with rice vinegar (fine) but 煮切り brush-on and the dipping soy are wheat. Ask for 塩 on the neta.

items.en: Assorted nigiri, ten pieces
items.section: 寿司 Sushi à la carte

items.en: Tekka-maki — tuna roll
items.section: 寿司 Sushi à la carte
items.note: Nori, rice and raw tuna — no wheat ingredient in the roll itself if the nori is unseasoned. Ask.

items.en: Kappa-maki — cucumber roll, the cheapest thing on the whole menu
items.section: 寿司 Sushi à la carte
items.note: Rice, nori and cucumber — genuinely plant-only. Confirm the sushi rice carries no dashi and skip the soy dip and it is close to wheat-free too.

items.ja: サービス寿司ランチ「由良川」
items.en: Yuragawa sushi lunch — appetiser, seven nigiri (toro, prawn, white fish, squid, lean tuna, shiny fish, ikura, uni) plus two futomaki, miso soup, dessert
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: The best-value way into this restaurant.

items.ja: おすすめ上握り寿司ランチ「八坂」
items.en: Yasaka premium nigiri lunch — appetiser and chawanmushi, nine nigiri including anago, plus a toro-tekka roll, miso soup, dessert
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 煮穴子 is simmered in soy; the chawanmushi is soy-seasoned too.

items.ja: おすすめちらし寿司ランチ「高瀬川」
items.en: Takasegawa chirashi lunch — a two-tier bowl: tuna, white fish, prawn, squid, shiny fish, scallop and tamago on top; simmered conger, ikura, kanpyo and shiitake below
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 干瓢 and 煮椎茸 are both simmered in soy and sugar; tamagoyaki usually carries mirin and soy.

items.ja: 上握り寿司ランチ「清水」
items.en: Kiyomizu premium nigiri lunch — appetiser and a small dish, then eleven pieces: otoro, chutoro, lean tuna, white fish, squid, prawn, shellfish, shiny fish, uni, ikura, simmered anago, a negitoro roll and tamago
items.section: 寿司カウンター 昼食 Sushi lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Not available in the private rooms — counter only.

items.ja: 料理長おすすめ寿司コース「味わい」
items.en: Ajiwai — the head chef's sushi course marking the hotel's 26th anniversary: appetiser, three sashimi, the signature Saikyo-miso silver cod, chawanmushi, then twelve selected nigiri including three cuts of bluefin
items.section: 寿司カウンター Sushi course

items.ja: 鉄板シーフードランチ「楓」
items.en: Kaede teppanyaki seafood lunch — today's soup, seasonal salad, grilled vegetables, sea bream and 'angel prawn' cooked on the plate in front of you, rice, pickles, miso soup, teppan dessert. Counter only, 12 seats, 11:30–14:30
items.price: ¥6,000（ガーリックライスに変更 +¥800／コーヒー・紅茶 +¥800）
items.section: 鉄板焼 昼食 Teppanyaki lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Teppan cooking uses a shared hot plate and the finishing sauce is normally soy and butter. Ask before the plate is seasoned, not after.

items.en: Gion teppanyaki lunch — today's fish as carpaccio, soup, seasonal salad, 80g of a rare lean cut of Yonezawa beef with grilled vegetables, then garlic rice or the chef's beef curry, pickles, Yamari miso soup, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: 鉄板焼 昼食 Teppanyaki lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 特製ビーフカレー — Japanese curry roux is a wheat-flour roux, always. Take the garlic rice instead, and ask about its soy. Supplements: today's seafood +¥2,000, foie gras +¥4,000, live abalone +¥6,000, spiny lobster +¥13,000.

items.ja: 活鮑付き鉄板焼きランチ「丹波」
items.romaji: Tanba — teppanyaki lunch with live abalone
items.en: Tanba teppanyaki lunch — carpaccio, soup, the chef's salad with house dressing, live abalone on the plate, 80g rare-cut Yonezawa beef, vegetables from around the country, garlic rice or beef curry, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: 鉄板焼 昼食 Teppanyaki lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Same curry-roux caveat.

items.ja: お手頃鉄板焼きディナー「大原」
items.en: Oohara teppanyaki dinner — carpaccio, soup, seasonal salad, 50g rare-cut Yonezawa beef with grilled vegetables, garlic rice or ume-and-baby-sardine rice, pickles, Yamari miso. Dessert with coffee or tea +¥2,500. Counter only, 17:00–22:00
items.section: 鉄板焼 夕食 Teppanyaki dinner (17:00–22:00)
items.note: 梅じゃこごはん is plum and dried sardine over rice — the most likely wheat-free carb here, but ask whether soy is used to season it.

items.ja: 本格鉄板焼きディナー「高雄」
items.en: Takao teppanyaki dinner — carpaccio, today's speciality, chef's salad, then a choice of 100g Yonezawa sirloin or 80g fillet with grilled vegetables, garlic rice or ume-jako rice
items.section: 鉄板焼 夕食 Teppanyaki dinner (17:00–22:00)
items.note: Teppanyaki dinners run up to ¥40,000 in the higher courses.

items.ja: 天婦羅ランチコース「明石」
items.en: Akashi tempura lunch — appetiser, two tiger prawns, two of today's fish, Japanese-style soup salad, lotus root, today's mushroom and one seasonal vegetable, a seasonal seafood kakiage, then your choice of tenbara-don, tendon or ten-cha, miso soup, pickles, dessert
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: Wheat batter throughout; tendon sauce is soy. Weekend and holiday counter seatings are 11:30 or 13:30, 90 minutes; weekdays are untimed.

items.ja: 野菜中心ヘルシー天ぷらコース「にぎわい」
items.romaji: Nigiwai — yasai chushin healthy tempura course
items.en: Nigiwai — weekday-lunch-only vegetable-led tempura course with a welcome drink: seasonal appetiser, tempura of prawn, yuba and nama-fu, a seafood-broth vegetable soup salad, three seasonal vegetables, today's seafood kakiage, a rice bowl of your choice, pickles, miso, and freshly made kuzukiri for dessert
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 生麩 is wheat gluten and the batter is wheat — this course puts gluten in twice on purpose. The 葛切り dessert, by contrast, is pure kudzu starch. Welcome drink is beer, alcohol-free beer, cola, oolong or orange juice.

items.ja: おすすめ天婦羅ランチ「北野」
items.en: Kitano tempura lunch — appetiser, two tiger prawns, today's white fish and anago, soup salad, seasonal vegetables, sweet potato, asparagus and mushroom, a small-prawn-and-scallop kakiage, then salt-tendon, tendon or ten-cha
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)
items.note: 塩天丼 is tempura over rice with salt instead of sauce — the sauce comes off, the batter does not.

items.ja: お造り付き特別ランチ「振る舞い」
items.romaji: Furumai — special tempura lunch with sashimi
items.en: Furumai — tempura lunch with two sashimi added ahead of the prawns, white fish and anago
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター 昼食 Tempura lunch (11:30–14:30)

items.ja: お勧め天婦羅コース「葵」
items.en: Aoi — the 26th-anniversary tempura course: early-summer appetiser, then wild tiger prawns, Seto Inland Sea hamo, young Lake Biwa ayu (or Edo-mae kisu or flathead once they run out), live black abalone, Hokkaido uni and large clam; a vegetable soup salad as a palate cleanser; Kyoto kamo-nasu, corn kakiage, asparagus and new lotus root
items.section: 天婦羅カウンター Tempura course

items.en: Rice set (rice, miso soup, pickles) ¥1,800; red miso soup alone ¥1,200
items.note: 赤出汁 is red miso — often 豆味噌 (soybean only, no grain) in this style, but the dashi is bonito.

items.ja: お抹茶とお菓子のセット
items.en: Matcha with a Japanese sweet
items.note: Matcha itself is fine but the 生菓子 served with it is a wheat or bean-paste confection; assume wheat. Ice cream is ¥1,000.

items.en: Room charges on top of the food: tatami rooms 紅梅 and 若紫 ¥22,000 each (4–10 people), both combined ¥33,000 (up to 30); private rooms 浮舟 ¥22,000 (4–12, with its own small garden), 梅枝 ¥11,000 (4–8), 朝顔 and 夕顔 ¥5,500 each (4–6, no door); the tea room 熊筌亭 ¥44,000, only bookable together with 浮舟
items.note: Private rooms take four people minimum. The à la carte list, and the Gion teppanyaki, Sagano tempura and Kiyomizu sushi courses, are NOT available in the rooms. 御祝い会席 and 法要会席 from ¥13,000 also exist.

items.ja: アレルギー対応について
items.en: The restaurant's own allergy statement: ingredients are checked against manufacturer information, but everything is cooked in one kitchen with shared equipment and washing machines, so trace allergen transfer is possible; the food is explicitly NOT a full allergy-safe menu, and they may decline service where a reaction would be severe
items.note: Recorded verbatim from the shop's own page because it is the single most useful line here: this kitchen does not claim allergen separation. Combined with soy sauce, dashi, tempura and 麩 running through nearly every course, a coeliac should not eat a course menu here without talking to the restaurant well in advance.

tokyo_tofu_ryori_kichiza_keio_.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own site (the page titles read とうふ料理吉座 京王百貨店新宿店, so these are this branch's lists, not the Kioicho original's), all marked 税込 — tax included. The 季節のおすすめ set is the summer 2026 rotation. Checked 2026-08-20. 8F of Keio Department Store Shinjuku, 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), closes with the store.

items.en: Small rice-bowl and Nikko tofu set — soy-milk tofu made with Nikko spring water, tofu dengaku with two misos (kinome and cherry-blossom), hijiki in mashed tofu dressing, ganmodoki simmered until it soaks, sesame tofu, today's small donburi, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet. The cheapest full set
items.note: 白和え and 含ませ are simmered in bonito dashi with soy; がんもどき is deep-fried in a shared fryer; the dengaku miso's grain base is undeclared. Vegetable-heavy but neither vegan nor wheat-free.

items.ja: さごしの西京焼きと牛ステーキ御膳
items.romaji: sagoshi no saikyo-yaki to gyu steak gozen
items.en: Saikyo-grilled young Spanish mackerel and beef steak set — Nikko tofu, sesame tofu, Nikko yuba sashimi, the grilled fish, a beef steak, edamame rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.note: 西京焼き is a sweet-miso marinade with sake and mirin; the steak sauce is soy-based.

items.en: Sukiyaki set — Nikko tofu, a three-part appetiser box (Nikko yuba sashimi, hijiki shira-ae, mizuna and abura-age in dashi), the sukiyaki pot, white rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.note: 割下, the sukiyaki broth, is soy sauce, mirin and sugar — wheat, unavoidably. Raw egg for dipping is standard.

items.en: Basket set — Nikko tofu, hijiki shira-ae, neri-dofu, mizuna and abura-age, simmered taro with grated daikon, Nikko yuba and tuna sashimi, beef steak, grilled fish, prawn-and-aubergine tempura, edamame rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet. Twelve components
items.note: Tempura is wheat batter from a shared fryer.

items.en: Yuba and tuna mini-kaiseki — house tofu, house sesame tofu, tofu cured in Saikyo miso, Nikko yuba and tuna sashimi, tuna grilled on a ceramic plate with a Nikko tofu steak, prawn and vegetable tempura, yuba shumai, and yuba chazuke to finish
items.note: ゆば焼売 — shumai wrappers are wheat. Plus tempura batter and the chazuke broth's soy. The most interesting set here and one of the least gluten-free.

items.ja: 海老天丼とミニすき焼き御膳
items.en: Prawn tendon and mini-sukiyaki set — Nikko tofu, simmered taro with grated daikon, a tendon of five prawns, a small sukiyaki pot, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.note: Tendon = wheat batter under a soy sauce; sukiyaki warishita = soy again.

items.en: Matsusaka beef sukiyaki set — Nikko tofu, the three-part appetiser box, 90g of Matsusaka beef in the sukiyaki pot, white rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.section: 季節のおすすめ Seasonal recommendations
items.note: Matsusaka is one of Japan's three great beef brands. Warishita is soy-based.

items.ja: ミニ鰻丼と冷やしうどん御膳
items.romaji: mini unadon to hiyashi udon gozen
items.en: Mini eel-rice and chilled udon set — chilled Nikko tofu, sesame tofu, assorted tempura, a small unagi donburi, cold udon, pickles, a sweet
items.section: 季節のおすすめ Seasonal recommendations
items.note: うどん is wheat noodle, the tsuyu is wheat soy sauce, the kabayaki glaze is soy, and the tempura is battered. Four wheat routes in one tray.

items.ja: 国産うな重と豆冨田楽御膳
items.romaji: kokusan unaju to tofu dengaku gozen
items.en: Domestic eel-box and tofu dengaku set — chilled Nikko tofu, two tofu dengaku (kinome miso and sakura miso), a lacquer box of domestic grilled eel over rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet. The most expensive set
items.section: 季節のおすすめ Seasonal recommendations
items.note: 蒲焼のたれ is soy, mirin and sugar reduced down — concentrated wheat.

items.romaji: hamo to katsuo no Kichiza bento
items.en: Kichiza bento of pike conger and bonito — twelve parts: chilled Nikko tofu, kumiage yuba, mizuna and abura-age in dashi, hijiki shira-ae, two tofu dengaku, tomato and cucumber in egg-yolk vinegar, seared bonito tataki, hamo tempura, edamame rice, tofu miso soup, pickles, a sweet
items.section: 吉座のおすすめ Kichiza recommendation
items.note: The bento to order if you want the widest spread for the money. 黄身酢 is egg yolk; hamo tempura is battered; katsuo tataki comes with ponzu, which is soy-based.

items.en: Nikko tofu — the house tofu, made from domestic soybeans and the famous spring water of Nikko; it appears in nearly every set, chilled as hiyayakko or as soy-milk tofu
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Soybeans, water and a coagulant — the block itself has no wheat and no animal product. What lands on it does: 冷奴 is served with soy sauce and usually katsuobushi flakes. Ask for it with salt and no bonito and this is the dish to eat here.

items.en: Sesame tofu — despite the name, ground sesame set with kudzu starch rather than soy
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Sesame and kudzu; no wheat in the block. Usually topped with wasabi and a soy-based sauce — ask them to leave the sauce off.

items.en: Nikko yuba sashimi — the skin skimmed from simmering soy milk, eaten raw. Nikko is one of the two towns in Japan famous for yuba, and its style is thicker and folded, unlike Kyoto's
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Soy milk only. The dipping soy sauce is the wheat; ask for salt.

items.ja: 豆冨田楽（木の芽味噌／桜味噌）
items.en: Tofu dengaku — tofu skewered and grilled under two misos: kinome, sharp with young sansho leaf, and sakura, made with cherry blossom
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: The miso's grain base is not declared — 麦味噌 would be barley — and dengaku miso is normally loosened with mirin and dashi. Ask.

items.en: Ganmodoki simmered until it soaks up the broth — deep-fried tofu patties studded with vegetable
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: Deep-fried, then simmered in bonito dashi and soy. Plant-based in origin, but neither vegan nor wheat-free as served.

items.en: Hijiki seaweed dressed in mashed tofu
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: 白和え dressing is tofu, sesame and sugar — but the hijiki is simmered in dashi and soy first.

items.ja: 水菜と油揚げの煮浸し
items.en: Mizuna and fried tofu steeped in dashi
items.price: 御膳に含む (included in the sets)
items.note: 煮浸し is by definition a bonito-dashi-and-soy steep.

items.ja: キリン一番搾り 生ビール
items.en: Kirin Ichibanshibori draft beer (bottled Kirin Lager, medium bottle, ¥979)

items.ja: 菊正宗 上撰 本醸造（兵庫）

items.ja: 澤乃井 奥多摩湧水仕込（東京）
items.en: Sawanoi, brewed with Okutama spring water — a Tokyo sake, from the mountains at the western end of the metropolis
items.note: Rice and water. Worth ordering as the local one.

items.ja: 銀盤 純米大吟醸（富山）
items.en: Ginban junmai daiginjo from Toyama — the top sake on the list, rice polished hard, nothing added
items.note: 純米 means rice and koji only, no added alcohol.

items.en: Kurokirishima sweet-potato shochu from Kagoshima — the best-selling imo-jochu in Japan (also 鬼火 and 一刻者 at ¥640, 晴耕雨読 ¥740, all sweet potato)
items.note: 芋焼酎 is distilled from sweet potato with RICE koji — no barley anywhere. This is the shochu shelf a coeliac can drink from.

items.en: Nikaido barley shochu from Oita — light and clean, the classic mugi-jochu
items.note: 麦 means BARLEY. Never order this one gluten-free — it is the single item on this drinks list most likely to catch someone out, sitting as it does among four sweet-potato shochus at the same price.

items.en: Kakutama plum wine ¥640; today's featured umeshu ¥740

items.en: Glass wine, red or white (bottle ¥3,140)

items.en: Oolong-hai — shochu cut with oolong tea

items.note: ウイスキーは麦由来。ジンサワーは蒸留原料次第だが、店は両者を同一項目で扱う。The whiskey highball is malt-derived. The gin version may be safer depending on the base grain, but the shop lists them as one line — ask if it matters.

items.ja: キッズオーガニックジュース
items.en: Organic juice for children
Add 15mg of CBD to any drink. Milk upgrade from soy to oat or almond +¥100
items.note: CBDは18歳以上、または保護者の許可がある方に提供。CBD is served to 18+ or with a guardian's permission; the board states this twice.

tokyo_shibuya_gapao_shokudo_ga.price_note: Prices from the group's own site (a STUDIO-CMS page whose menu data was pulled from the published snapshot), current as of checking. The Thai dish names come from the shop's own Tabelog listing (updated 2021-08) matched to the identical Japanese dish name; where no Thai name is evidenced for a dish, only the Japanese name is given rather than a guess. Note the Tabelog prices are ~10–15% below the site's current ones, so use the figures here. Branch confirmed as 渋谷区桜丘町14-10 渋谷コープ1F. Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00).

items.ja: ランチセット（サラダ・スープ付き）
items.en: Weekday lunch set — one main plus salad and soup. The price ladder runs ¥1,080 / ¥1,180 / ¥1,230 / ¥1,380 depending on which main you pick
items.section: 平日のランチ Weekday lunch (11:30–15:00, L.O. 14:30)
items.note: タイ料理の基本調味料ナンプラー・オイスターソース・シーユーには小麦が入ることが多い。Thai cooking here leans on fish sauce, oyster sauce and Thai soy — oyster sauce and Thai dark soy routinely contain wheat, and fish sauce defeats vegan. Ask per dish; the shop does not publish allergens.

items.en: Lunch add-ons — extras run ¥100, ¥150, ¥200 or ¥300 (extra rice, fried egg, coriander and similar)
items.section: 平日のランチ Weekday lunch
items.note: 個別の品目名は店頭表示。The site prices the add-ons without naming each one — read the table card.

items.ja: ホリデーランチ：エビチャーハン＋マッサマンカレー セット
items.romaji: holiday lunch — kao pat kung + gaeng massaman set
items.en: Weekend/holiday set: the prawn fried rice cooked fast over high heat, paired with the mild, sweet massaman curry. The shop calls this pairing foolproof
items.section: ホリデーランチ Weekend & holiday lunch
items.note: チャーハンにはナンプラー・醤油、マッサマンにもナンプラーが入るのが通例。Fried rice is seasoned with fish sauce and soy; massaman also carries fish sauce. Not vegan; ask about wheat in the soy and oyster sauces. Eleven mains are offered with a small dish or a drink.

items.ja: ホリデーランチ：シーフードガパオ＋グリーンカレー セット
items.romaji: holiday lunch — pat kaphrao talay + gaeng kiao wan set
items.en: Weekend/holiday set: seafood gapao stir-fry over rice with a half-set fried egg, plus the spicy green curry
items.section: ホリデーランチ Weekend & holiday lunch
items.note: ガパオ炒めはオイスターソース・シーユーダム使用が一般的＝小麦の可能性。Gapao stir-fry normally uses oyster sauce and Thai dark soy, both common wheat carriers — ask. Egg and seafood.

items.ja: ホリデーランチ：ソムタム＋トムヤムクン セット
items.romaji: holiday lunch — som tam + tom yum kung set
items.en: Weekend/holiday set: the green papaya salad with the classic hot-and-sour prawn soup
items.section: ホリデーランチ Weekend & holiday lunch
items.note: ソムタムには干しエビとナンプラー、トムヤムクンにもナンプラー。Som tam carries dried shrimp and fish sauce; tom yum the same. Not vegan. Both are usually wheat-free, but the shop publishes no allergen data — ask.

items.ja: ＊土日祝のランチはグランドメニュー全品から注文可
items.romaji: weekend lunch — full grand menu available
items.en: On weekends and holidays the full à la carte menu is served at lunch as well, not just the sets
items.section: ホリデーランチ Weekend & holiday lunch
items.note: 店の注記。The shop's own note on the menu page.

items.ja: ソムタム・タイ（青パパイヤのサラダ）
items.en: Green papaya pounded in a mortar with lime, chilli, dried shrimp and peanuts — sour, salty, hot and crunchy all at once
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: 干しエビ・ナンプラー使用。The dressing carries dried shrimp and fish sauce, so it is not vegan. Fish sauce itself is usually wheat-free but Thai kitchens often add ซีอิ๊ว soy — ask.

items.ja: ヤム・ウンセン（春雨サラダ）
items.en: Glass-noodle salad — mung-bean noodles tossed with chicken, squid and prawn, sharp with lime and loud with coriander. The shop calls it its number-one salad
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: 春雨は緑豆でんぷんで小麦不使用だが、ドレッシングにナンプラー・醤油。The glass noodles are mung-bean starch, not wheat — but the dressing carries fish sauce and often soy. Ask.

items.ja: ラープ・ガイ（鶏粗挽き肉のイサン風サラダ）
items.en: Larb — minced chicken tossed warm with toasted rice powder, lime, chilli and herbs. Isan food, meant to be eaten with sticky rice
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: 炒り米粉は米、味付けはナンプラー。The toasted rice powder is rice, not wheat; the seasoning is fish sauce. Ask about added soy.

items.ja: ヤム・カイダオ（タマゴサラダ）
items.en: Fried-egg salad — a crisp-edged fried egg cut up and dressed while still warm
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: 卵とナンプラーのドレッシング。Egg plus fish-sauce dressing.

items.ja: ムー・マナーオ（豚肉のレモン風味サラダ）
items.en: Sliced pork under a lime, garlic and chilli dressing
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: ナンプラーベース。Fish-sauce based.

items.ja: 牛肉のイサーン風サラダ
items.en: Isan-style beef salad — grilled beef sliced into the same lime-and-chilli dressing
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: タイ語名は店の公開資料に記載なし（豚版は ムー・ナムトック）。The shop publishes no Thai name for the beef version — the pork equivalent is listed as ムー・ナムトック, so this is presumably neua nam tok, but that is inference, not the shop's word. Fish-sauce dressing.

items.ja: 竹の子のイサーン風サラダ
items.en: Isan-style bamboo-shoot salad
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。イサーンの筍サラダは通常ナンプラー・プラーラー使用。No Thai name published by the shop. Isan bamboo salad normally carries fish sauce and often fermented fish — ask before treating it as the vegetarian option it looks like.

items.ja: 豚挽き肉サラダのレタス包み
items.en: Minced-pork salad served with lettuce leaves to wrap it in
items.section: 前菜 サラダ Appetiser — salads
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published. Fish-sauce dressed pork.

items.ja: ポピア・ソット（タイ風生春巻き）
items.en: Fresh spring rolls — soft rice paper, unfried. The shop's most-ordered starter
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: ライスペーパーは米粉だが、つけダレ（スイートチリ／ピーナッツ）に小麦や魚醤が入りうる。The rice paper is rice flour, which makes this the most plausible gluten-free starter — but the dipping sauce is the risk, and the filling may contain prawn or pork. Ask about both.

items.ja: カイ・チアオ・ムー・サップ（豚挽肉入りタイ風オムレツ）
items.en: Thai omelette with minced pork — fried hard so the edges puff and crisp, eaten over rice
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: 卵と豚肉、味付けはナンプラー。Egg and pork; fish sauce in the mix.

items.ja: 鶏粗挽き肉のイサン風料理（アラカルト）
items.en: Coarse-minced chicken, Isan style — the à la carte portion
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published for this à la carte listing. Fish sauce.

items.ja: トート・マン・プラー（タイ風さつま揚げ）
items.en: Thai fish cakes — red-curry-paste fish paste, bouncy and deep-fried, with cucumber relish
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦粉、揚げ油も共用。Fish-cake paste is bound with wheat flour and this comes out of a shared fryer.

items.ja: プラー・ラート・プリック（揚げ魚のスパイシーあんかけ）
items.en: A whole fish deep-fried and buried in sweet, sour, garlicky chilli sauce
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: 揚げ衣とあんのとろみに小麦粉、タレにも醤油。Wheat in the coating and usually in the thickened sauce, plus soy.

items.ja: ガイ・ヤーン（鶏もも肉のバーベキュー）
items.en: Grilled chicken thigh marinated in the shop's own sauce — Isan street-grill food
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: マリネ液にシーユー（タイ醤油）やオイスターソースが使われるのが一般的。Thai grill marinades usually contain soy and often oyster sauce — both wheat risks. Ask.

items.ja: コー・ムー・ヤーン（豚のど肉のあぶり焼き）
items.en: Grilled pork neck, sliced, with a sharp jaew dipping sauce
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: マリネ液・タレに醤油系調味料。Soy-family seasonings in the marinade and dip — ask.

items.en: Grilled prawns
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。つけダレの内容を要確認。No Thai name published; the dipping sauce is the wheat risk.

items.ja: パックブン・ファイデーン（空芯菜炒め）
items.en: Morning glory flash-fried over a roaring flame with garlic and chilli — the stalks stay squeaky
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: タオチオ（発酵大豆）・オイスターソース・ナンプラーが定番の味付け。Looks like the vegetarian option and often is not: the standard seasoning is fermented soybean plus oyster sauce and fish sauce. Oyster sauce is a common wheat carrier. Ask for both — a plain garlic-and-chilli version is usually possible.

items.ja: クン・ガティアム（エビのにんにく風味炒め）
items.en: Prawns stir-fried hard with garlic and white pepper
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: 醤油・オイスターソースを使うことが多い。Soy and oyster sauce likely — ask.

items.ja: プーニム・パッ・プリック・タイダム（ソフトシェルクラブの黒胡椒炒め）
items.romaji: poo nim pad prik thai dam
items.en: Soft-shell crab stir-fried in black pepper — you eat the shell and all
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: ソフトシェルクラブは小麦粉をまぶして揚げるのが一般的、ソースにも醤油。The crab is normally dusted in wheat flour and fried before the sauce goes on.

items.en: Aubergine stir-fried with holy basil in the gapao style
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。ガパオ炒めの基本はオイスターソース・シーユー・ナンプラー。No Thai name published. Gapao seasoning is built on oyster sauce, Thai soy and fish sauce, so the vegetable version is neither automatically vegan nor automatically wheat-free — ask specifically.

items.ja: プーニム・パッポン・カリー（ソフトシェルクラブの玉子カレー炒め）
items.en: Soft-shell crab in the yellow curry-and-egg stir-fry — rich, mild, meant for rice
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: 小麦粉をまぶした揚げカニ＋卵。Wheat-dusted crab plus egg.

items.ja: ガパオ・ガイ・ラート・カーオ（鶏肉のガパオごはん）
items.en: The dish the shop is named after: chicken and holy basil stir-fried and poured over rice, deliberately soupier than most versions. The basil is always fresh, never dried, and the shop makes a point of it
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 「コダワリの複数調味料」＝オイスターソース・シーユー・ナンプラーの併用が想定される。The shop's own description boasts of a multi-sauce seasoning blend, which in practice means oyster sauce and Thai soy — wheat risks — plus fish sauce. Usually topped with a fried egg. Ask.

items.ja: ガパオ・ムー・ラート・カーオ（豚肉のガパオごはん）
items.en: The same gapao over rice, made with pork
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 同じ調味料構成。Same sauce base — ask.

items.ja: ガパオ・ヌア・ラート・カーオ（牛肉のガパオごはん）
items.en: Gapao over rice made with beef
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 同じ調味料構成。

items.ja: ガパオ・タレー・ラート・カーオ（シーフードのガパオごはん）
items.en: Gapao over rice with mixed seafood
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 同じ調味料構成。

items.ja: カーオ・パッ・クン（エビチャーハン）
items.en: Prawn fried rice, finished fast over a high flame
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 醤油・ナンプラーで味付け。Seasoned with soy and fish sauce — ask about the soy.

items.ja: カーオ・トム・クン（エビのお粥）
items.en: Prawn rice soup — a loose, comforting rice porridge, the Thai hangover cure
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 出汁とナンプラー。Stock and fish sauce.

items.ja: カオマンガイ（蒸し鶏のせライス）
items.en: Poached chicken on rice cooked in the chicken stock with plenty of ginger and garlic, served with the shop's own hot sauce to spoon over
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: カオマンガイのタレはタオチオ（発酵大豆）とシーユーが基本＝小麦の可能性大。The sauce that makes this dish is fermented soybean and Thai soy, which is exactly where the wheat would be. Ask, or ask for it without the sauce.

items.ja: ゲーン・マッサマン（マッサマンカレー）
items.en: Massaman — the southern Thai curry with coconut milk, potato, peanut and the sour note of tamarind. Mild. CNN once called it the best dish in the world and the shop has not stopped mentioning it
items.section: メイン カレー Main — curries
items.note: カレーペーストにエビペースト（カピ）、仕上げにナンプラー。Thai curry pastes contain shrimp paste and the finish is fish sauce, so not vegan. Usually wheat-free, but ask.

items.ja: ゲーン・キアオ・ガイ（鶏肉のグリーンカレー）
items.en: Green curry with chicken — chicken stock, green chilli heat and Thai sweet basil (horapha) against coconut sweetness
items.section: メイン カレー Main — curries
items.note: ペーストにカピ（エビペースト）、ナンプラーで調味。Shrimp paste in the curry paste, fish sauce in the seasoning.

items.ja: ゲーン・ペット・クン（エビのレッドカレー）
items.en: Red curry with prawns
items.section: メイン カレー Main — curries
items.note: 同上。Same shrimp-paste and fish-sauce base.

items.en: Thai noodle soup — rice noodles in broth
items.section: メイン 麺類 Main — noodles
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。米麺だが、スープに醤油系調味料が入るのが一般的。Thai noodles are rice, which is promising, but the broth is normally seasoned with soy — ask.

items.ja: タイ風汁そば（トムヤムスープ）
items.en: Thai noodle soup in tom yum broth — hot and sour
items.section: メイン 麺類 Main — noodles
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published. Rice noodles; fish sauce and possibly soy in the broth.

items.ja: タイ風焼きそば（パッタイ）
items.en: Pad thai — flat rice noodles fried with tamarind, egg, bean sprouts and crushed peanut
items.section: メイン 麺類 Main — noodles
items.note: 米麺は小麦不使用だが、パッタイソースに醤油・エビが入るのが定番。The noodles are rice, but pad thai sauce standardly carries soy and dried shrimp, and the dish contains egg. Ask.

items.ja: トムヤムクン（エビのトムヤムスープ）
items.en: Tom yum kung — prawn soup sharp with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaf and chilli
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: ナンプラー、ペーストにカピ。Fish sauce and shrimp paste.

items.ja: トムカーガイ（鶏肉のココナツミルクスープ）
items.en: Tom kha gai — chicken in a coconut-milk soup mellowed with galangal
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: タイ語名は店の英語表記に基づく一般名。ナンプラー使用。Fish sauce.

items.ja: 豆腐と春雨のさっぱりスープ
items.en: A clear, light soup with tofu and glass noodles — the gentlest thing on the menu
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。タイの澄ましスープは豚だしとナンプラーが基本。No Thai name published. Thai clear soups are normally pork stock with fish sauce — this is not the vegetarian dish it looks like unless the kitchen confirms it. Ask.

items.ja: シーフードのトムヤムスープ
items.en: Tom yum with mixed seafood
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published. Fish sauce and shrimp paste.

items.ja: タピオカ・ココナツミルク
items.en: Tapioca pearls in coconut milk
items.note: タピオカはキャッサバでんぷんで小麦不使用。ココナツミルクベースなら乳製品不使用。Tapioca is cassava starch, so wheat-free, and coconut milk means no dairy — this is the most likely vegan and gluten-free dessert here, but the shop publishes nothing, so ask.

items.ja: タロイモのタイ風プリン
items.en: Thai-style taro pudding
items.note: タイのプリンは卵や小麦粉を使うものもある。Some Thai puddings use egg or wheat flour — ask.

items.en: Coconut pudding
items.note: ゼラチンか寒天か未公開。Set with gelatine or agar — not stated, which matters for vegan. Ask.

items.ja: もち米の温かいおもち
items.en: Warm sticky-rice sweet
items.note: もち米は小麦不使用。Sticky rice is wheat-free in itself; the accompaniments are not published.

items.ja: タロイモともち米の温かいデザート
items.en: Warm taro and sticky-rice dessert
items.note: 同上。Same — ask.

items.en: A course of northeastern Isan dishes — the shop's popular one. With two hours of all-you-can-drink including draught beer, ¥4,980
items.note: 飲み放題に生ビール＝麦芽。The drink package includes draught beer, which is malt. Course contents are not itemised on the site — ask when booking if you have a restriction.

items.en: The classic course — the popular starters and the Thai standards. With two hours of all-you-can-drink including draught beer, ¥5,980
items.note: 同上、内容は未公開。Contents not itemised.

items.ja: 特別プランコース（全8品）
items.en: Eight courses built from the à la carte greatest hits. With the drink package, ¥5,480
items.note: 内容は未公開。Contents not itemised.

items.en: Takeaway bento sold at the counter every day, from ¥600, with delivery and a subscription option
items.note: 内容は日替わり。Contents change daily; Uber Eats delivery is also offered.

tokyo_oiwake_dango_honpo_shinj.price_note: Every price and every allergen note comes from the shop's own site — the 喫茶室 (tearoom) page for the eat-in sets and one product page per skewer for the counter prices. Prices tax-included as printed. Counter sales 10:30–19:00; tearoom weekdays 12:00–18:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–18:00, L.O. 17:30, no seat reservations. The site still carries a 2022 COVID notice suspending the tearoom, but it is commented out in the page source and a 2026-04-29 shop announcement reopened the summer shaved-ice service in the tearoom — the tearoom is running. Shop closes when the day's dango sell out.

items.en: Two skewers of your choice, plated with tea in the tearoom — the standard order
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: 選んだ串によって小麦の有無が変わる（みたらし・生醤油・のり系・胡麻たれは小麦、あん系は表示なし）。Whether this is wheat-free depends entirely on which two skewers you pick: the shop's own allergen lines flag 小麦 on the mitarashi, kijoyu, nori and sesame skewers but list no allergens at all on the bean-paste ones. Choose こしあん / 小倉 / 白あん / きなこあん / 抹茶あん / よもぎ and it is a different dish allergen-wise. Ask about dashi in the tea service for vegan.

items.en: Anmitsu — cubes of Amakusa agar jelly with the house red bean paste, Hokkaido red peas and seasonal fruit, under Okinawan brown-sugar syrup you pour yourself
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: 商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。Neither the tearoom page nor the anmitsu product page lists any allergen, unlike the soy-glazed skewers which are explicitly flagged 小麦. Agar, beans, fruit and black-sugar syrup are all plant and wheat-free by nature — but the shop has not stated it, so ask rather than assume.

items.en: Country-style red bean soup, restrained in sweetness so the azuki flavour comes through, with a piece of mochi toasted until it blisters. In summer it becomes chilled shiruko with shiratama dumplings instead
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: 商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged by the shop. Azuki, sugar and rice mochi carry no wheat inherently — ask to be sure, and note the summer version swaps the grilled mochi for shiratama.

items.ja: 味の散歩（みたらしだんご・あんみつ・ところてん）
items.en: 'A stroll of flavours' — a tray of three small bowls: a mitarashi skewer, anmitsu, and tokoroten (chilled agar noodles). The tearoom's most-ordered set
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: みたらしだんごは店の表示で特定原材料「小麦」。ところてんの三杯酢も通常は醤油ベース。The mitarashi skewer in this set is flagged 小麦 by the shop itself, and the tokoroten vinegar dressing is normally soy-based too. Not gluten-free as served.

items.ja: 田舎小路（みたらしだんご・あんみつ・田舎しるこ）
items.en: Three of the house sweets on one tray: a mitarashi skewer, anmitsu and the country shiruko. In summer the shiruko becomes the chilled version with shiratama
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: みたらしだんごに「小麦」表示あり。The mitarashi skewer is flagged 小麦 by the shop.

items.ja: かき氷（氷抹茶・いちご・きなこ・氷あずき）
items.romaji: kakigori — kori matcha / ichigo / kinako / kori azuki
items.en: Summer shaved ice, served in the tearoom: Nishio matcha with its refined bitterness, strawberry, kinako soy flour, and 'kori azuki' under the shop's own zenzai bean paste

tokyo_cafe_and_macrobi.price_note: NEEDS A HUMAN LOOK. Items and prices are transcribed from photographs of the shop's own printed lunch and morning cards dated 2016-08 — the only menu that exists anywhere reachable. The shop relaunched as 発酵 andMACROBI in July 2017 at the same address (渋谷2-7-4 1F), and BOTH Tabelog listings (13198945 and 13212657) now read 「このお店は店舗情報の確認が取れていないため掲載保留中です」; the shop's domain and-macrobi.com no longer resolves, and web.archive.org was returning 'temporarily offline' during this pass so the archived /cafe pages could not be read. Treat every price as ten years old and confirm the shop is trading before travelling.

tokyo_milan_nataraj_shibuya.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own 渋谷店 menu page, tax included, checked 2026-08-20. The whole restaurant is vegetarian — there is no meat, fish or fish stock in the building; the 'soy meat' dishes are textured soy protein.

items.en: Palak paneer, medium hot — the shop's most popular curry. Spinach (their own farm's, in season) with soft house-made paneer that eats like a mild tofu
items.note: パニール＝乳。カレー自体に小麦は通常入らないが、インド料理のヒング（アサフェティダ）は小麦粉で増量した製品が主流＝要確認。店のメニューにも「ナッツ、小麦アレルギーの方はお申し出ください」とある。Paneer means dairy. The usual hidden gluten in an Indian kitchen is asafoetida cut with wheat flour — the menu itself invites you to declare a wheat allergy, so do.

items.en: Charcoal skewer set of seven — sasami, gizzard, white liver, tsukune, negima, wing, ponchiri (tail fat)

items.en: Tsubo — the 'pot', the small hollow of meat at the hip; one per bird
Shishito peppers, grilled on a skewer
items.note: Vegetable in itself, but grilled over the same charcoal as the chicken and usually brushed with the same tare. Ask for 塩 and accept the shared grill.

items.ja: しいたけ／ネギ／ナス／にんにく
items.en: Grilled shiitake, leek, aubergine or garlic, each on a skewer
items.note: Same shared-grill and tare caveat.

items.ja: 銀杏／ミニトマト／エリンギ
items.en: Ginkgo nuts, cherry tomatoes or king oyster mushroom, grilled
items.note: 銀杏 are salted only as a rule — the closest thing to a safe skewer.

items.en: Karaage — marinated chicken, floured and deep-fried (half portion ¥495)
items.note: 唐揚げ is dusted with wheat flour or a flour-and-potato-starch mix, the marinade is soy, and the fryer is shared. Three reasons.

items.en: Deep-fried cartilage
items.note: Same batter and fryer.

items.en: The shop's rolled omelette, made with care (large ¥1,320)
items.note: Japanese dashimaki is seasoned with dashi and 薄口醤油 — light soy sauce, still wheat.

items.en: House chicken skin in ponzu
items.note: ポン酢 is citrus plus soy sauce. Wheat.

items.ja: 大根とじゃこのパリパリサラダ
items.romaji: daikon to jako no paripari salad
items.en: Crisp daikon and dried baby sardine salad
items.note: Japanese salad dressings are soy-based more often than not. Fish.

items.ja: 海老とベーコンの水菜サラダ
items.romaji: ebi to bacon no mizuna salad
items.en: Prawn and bacon salad on mizuna

items.ja: 鶏モツと根菜の煮込み
items.en: Chicken offal simmered with root vegetables
items.note: 煮込み is a soy-and-mirin simmer.

items.ja: コラーゲンスープの坦々春雨
items.en: Dan-dan glass noodles in the collagen broth — harusame rather than wheat noodles
items.note: 春雨 are mung-bean or potato starch noodles, so the noodle itself is wheat-free — genuinely useful to know. The dan-dan sauce, though, is sesame paste plus soy and chilli bean paste (豆板醤, which usually contains wheat). Ask.

items.ja: 自家製らっきょう漬け／漬物盛り合せ
items.en: House-pickled rakkyo shallots ¥660; assorted pickles ¥715
items.note: らっきょう is normally a sweet-vinegar pickle with no soy — one of the safer small plates. Mixed pickles vary.

items.ja: とろける こだわり親子丼
items.en: The famous oyakodon — chicken and egg over rice, set so softly you eat it with a spoon. The reason many people come at lunch
items.section: お食事 Rice bowls (also the lunch headline)
items.note: 親子丼 is simmered in dashi, soy sauce and mirin. Wheat via the soy, always.

items.en: Charcoal-grilled chicken over rice
items.note: Glazed in tare.

items.en: Half grilled chicken, half oyakodon, in one bowl
items.note: Priced ¥1,430 on the lunch list and ¥1,540 on the main list — the lunch price is the current one.

items.ja: やみつき温玉そぼろ丼
items.en: Minced chicken soboro over rice with a soft-boiled onsen egg
items.note: そぼろ is minced chicken cooked down in soy and sugar.

items.en: The Tori Yoshi bowl — the house's own loaded chicken donburi and the most expensive rice dish
Chicken rice porridge with a soft egg — light, and the thing to order if you are tired
items.note: Built on the chicken broth; the seasoning is the question. Ask whether soy goes in.

items.ja: 自家製鶏カレーの玉子丼
items.en: House chicken curry over rice with egg (お新香 pickles included on the lunch list)
items.note: Japanese curry is thickened with a wheat-flour roux. Effectively never gluten-free.

items.en: Karaage set meal — lunch only
items.note: Lunch bookings are not taken.

items.en: All-chicken bowl — lunch only

items.ja: 焼きおにぎり二色（味噌・醤油）
items.en: Two grilled rice balls, one miso and one soy
items.note: Both glazes are wheat routes — 醤油 outright, 味噌 depending on the grain base.

items.ja: 鶏飯茶漬け／焼きおにぎり茶漬け
items.en: Chicken rice or a grilled rice ball in hot broth to close the meal
items.note: Chazuke broth is dashi and soy.

items.en: A bowl of the house collagen broth on its own (mini ¥495)
Seared-chicken hotpot course, 2–30 people
items.note: Built on the soy broth. Private-room bookings must take a hotpot course.

items.ja: コラーゲンスープの水炊きコース
items.en: Collagen mizutaki course, 2–30 people
The all-in Tori Yoshi course, spring/summer/autumn only, 2–4 people, book ahead — two tiers
The easy course — the cheapest set
Asahi draft, medium (small ¥385, bottle ¥715, Asahi black small bottle ¥660, Heartland small bottle ¥660)
items.note: Barley beer — never gluten-free. The alcohol-free beers (Asahi/Kirin, ¥550) are malt drinks too.

items.ja: 生レモンサワー／橙サワー／柚子サワー
items.romaji: nama lemon sour / daidai sour / yuzu sour
items.en: Shochu sours with fresh lemon, daidai bitter orange or yuzu
items.note: Depends on the shochu base — this shop stocks both 芋 (sweet potato) and 麦 (barley). Ask for 芋.

items.ja: 芋 さつま司（ボトル720ml）
items.en: Satsuma Tsukasa sweet-potato shochu, 720ml bottle
items.note: 芋焼酎 — distilled from sweet potato on rice koji, with no barley anywhere in it. This is the bottle to order.

items.en: Nikaido barley shochu, 900ml bottle
items.note: 麦 means BARLEY. Sitting right beside the sweet-potato bottle at a similar price — read the character before you point.

items.en: Sake by the go (180ml): Hitotsumatsu Shizuoka ¥660, Ichinokura Miyagi ¥770, Uonuma Niigata ¥770, Suigei Kochi ¥935, Momokawa Aomori ¥935, Hannyato Wakayama ¥935, Hakkaisan Niigata ¥1,045. Four-go bottles ¥3,740
items.note: Sake is rice, water and koji — no wheat. In a yakitori shop where the tare is soy, the sake is the safe half of the order.

items.ja: 凍結酒 玉乃光（京都）
items.en: Frozen sake — Tamanohikari unpasteurised namazake flash-frozen to a slush
items.note: Worth ordering for the texture alone. Rice and water.

items.ja: 角玉梅酒／杏露酒／藍苺酒
items.en: Plum wine ¥660, apricot liqueur ¥715, blueberry liqueur ¥715
items.note: The spirit base of Japanese fruit liqueurs is sometimes barley shochu. Ask.

items.ja: ウイスキー・ハイボール
items.en: Black Nikka frozen highball ¥660; Super Nikka single ¥770
items.note: Malted-barley distillate — treated as not gluten-free here.

items.ja: ウーロンハイ／緑茶ハイ
items.en: Shochu with oolong or green tea
items.note: Ask which shochu — the house pours both sweet potato and barley. Neither tea is 麦茶, so the mixer is fine.

tokyo_shinshuya_sobadokoro_shi.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own 公式 Tabelog listing, 税込, 更新日 2025-02-28. Checked 2026-08-20. A standing/quick soba counter one minute from Shibuya station: open 07:30–23:00 weekdays, 09:00–23:00 weekends, closed only on New Year's Day, no reservations. Almost everything is under ¥1,000.

items.en: Kake soba — the plain bowl: buckwheat noodles in hot broth, nothing on top. The cheapest thing in the shop (large ¥520)
items.note: Station soba is a wheat-and-buckwheat blend, usually mostly wheat, and the つゆ is dashi with wheat soy sauce. Even 十割 soba is not gluten-free in Japan (dusting flour on the board), and this is not 十割. Bonito dashi, so not vegan either. Udon is available in place of soba on every item at the same price.

items.en: Tanuki soba — with tenkasu, the crisp scraps of tempura batter, which soften into the broth (large ¥600; chilled version ¥480)
items.note: 天かす is fried wheat batter. The single most wheat-dense topping on the board.

items.en: Kitsune soba — topped with a sheet of sweet-simmered fried tofu (large ¥610; chilled ¥490)
items.note: 油揚げ is simmered in soy and sugar; the broth is bonito. Named for the fox, who is said to love it.

items.en: Wakame soba — with soft seaweed (large ¥590)
items.note: Wakame itself is fine; the noodle and broth are not.

items.en: Tsukimi soba — 'moon-viewing', a raw egg cracked into the hot broth to poach (large ¥590)
items.note: Raw egg.

items.en: Kakiage soba — a fritter of shredded vegetable and small prawn, dropped on top and left to collapse into the broth (large ¥680; chilled ¥560)
items.note: Deep-fried wheat batter.

items.en: Tororo soba — grated yamaimo, viscous and cool, over the noodles (large ¥720; chilled ¥600)
items.note: The yam is naturally gluten-free but the noodle and tsuyu are not. It makes some people's mouths itch — that is normal.

items.en: Tempura soba — with a battered prawn (large ¥770)
Ika-ten soba — with battered squid, a Tokyo standing-soba staple (large ¥770; いか天せいろ chilled ¥640, large ¥760)
Curry soba — the broth thickened into curry
items.note: Japanese curry is built on a wheat-flour roux, on top of the wheat noodle.

items.en: Mori soba — cold noodles drained on a tray, dipped into cold tsuyu (large ¥510)
items.note: The cheapest cold bowl. Same wheat-blend noodle and soy tsuyu.

items.en: Zaru soba — mori soba with shredded nori on top (large ¥560)

items.ja: 天もりそば／天ざるそば
items.en: Cold soba with tempura on the side — ten-mori ¥640 (large ¥760), ten-zaru with nori ¥690 (large ¥810)
Chilled soba in a sesame-paste sauce — the one dish here that is not the standard dashi formula
items.note: Sesame sauces are loosened with soy and dashi. Wheat and fish.

items.en: Toku-mori ¥650 / toku-zaru ¥700 — the 'special' extra-large cold portions
Tendon — tempura over rice under a sweet soy sauce
items.note: Batter and sauce, both wheat.

items.en: Katsudon — panko-crumbed pork cutlet simmered with onion and egg over rice
items.note: パン粉 is breadcrumb; the simmering liquid is soy.

items.en: Oyakodon — chicken and egg over rice
items.note: Soy-and-mirin simmer.

items.en: Curry over rice, Japanese-style
items.note: Wheat-flour roux.

items.en: Bowl-and-soba sets — tendon, oyakodon or curry-don with kake or mori soba ¥840; katsudon set ¥920; mini versions ¥730 (mini katsudon ¥800)
items.note: The standard Tokyo lunch: a small bowl and a small soba. Every combination contains wheat.

items.en: Add-ons: egg ¥70, wakame ¥68, tenkasu ¥80, kitsune abura-age ¥90, kakiage ¥160, tororo ¥200, prawn tempura ¥250, squid tempura ¥250, maitake tempura ¥250, five-kind tempura platter ¥760
items.note: わかめ (¥68) and とろろ (¥200) are the only two with no wheat in themselves — everything fried is battered.

items.ja: おにぎり（メンタイ／シャケ）
items.en: Rice balls — spicy cod roe or salmon, ¥160 each
items.note: Rice, nori and a filling — no wheat ingredient in principle, but mentaiko cure normally contains soy sauce and the nori may be soy-seasoned. The closest thing here to a wheat-free order, if you ask.

tokyo_shinjuku_wine_sakaba.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own 公式 Tabelog listing, 税込, 更新日 2026-06-27 — genuinely current. Checked 2026-08-20. There is a ¥500 (税抜) cover charge per person. Open 16:00–24:00 weekdays, 14:00–24:00 weekends, no closing day. The shop asks guests not to wear strong perfume.

items.en: 'The Sun of Prawns' — twelve prawns grilled and fanned out into a sunburst, heavy with prawn-head miso. The house signature and what the room orders
items.section: 名物／メイン Signature and mains
items.note: Grilled prawns with their own tomalley — no built-in wheat, but ask what they are basted with and whether bread comes with it.

items.ja: ムール貝のワイン蒸し
items.en: Mussels steamed in the wine the staff recommend that day
items.section: 名物／メイン Signature and mains
items.note: Wine, garlic and shellfish liquor — normally wheat-free, but mussels are almost always served with bread to mop up. Ask them to hold it.

items.ja: イベリコ豚のカツレツ
items.en: Iberico pork cutlet, breaded and fried

items.en: Oysters confit — cooked slow and low in oil

items.en: Today's raw oysters — priced by market and introduced by origin, from ¥700 a piece

items.ja: うずらの青唐辛子巻き

items.section: とりあえず一品 To start with

items.ja: オイルサーディン 〜パクチーライム〜

items.section: とりあえず一品 To start with

items.en: Giant Pacific octopus with jalapeño
items.section: とりあえず一品 To start with

items.en: Whitebait ajillo — baby sardines bubbling in garlic oil

items.ja: イイダコのガリシア風
items.en: Pulpo a la gallega with baby octopus — potato, paprika and olive oil

items.ja: ポテトフライ（コンソメorハーブソルト）
items.en: Chips with your choice of consommé powder or herb salt

items.en: Edamame with chorizo

items.ja: イベリコ豚のギョウザ（2P）
items.en: Iberico pork gyoza, two pieces

items.ja: 羊のシェリービネガー煮込み
items.en: Lamb braised in sherry vinegar

items.ja: 自家製フォカッチャ（1枚）
items.en: House focaccia, one piece — ¥90, the cheapest item on the whole menu

items.ja: 蜂蜜チーズPIZZA／生ハムパクチーPIZZA
items.romaji: hachimitsu cheese pizza / nama-hamu pakuchi pizza
items.en: Snack pizzas — honey and cheese ¥1,100, prosciutto and coriander ¥1,000
items.note: Wheat base; the honey one is not vegan either.

items.en: Bolognese of beef, pork AND chicken — three meats in one ragù

tokyo_asakusa_onigiri_haruchan.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own 公式 Tabelog listing, 税込, 更新日 2025-12-28. Checked 2026-08-20. Onigiri are priced in bands (¥390/¥410/¥460/¥690) and any rice ball can take two fillings for +¥100.

items.en: Salt musubi — nothing but rice and Setouchi moshio sea salt, so you taste the grain and the way it is packed. Available with or without nori
items.note: Rice, salt and water. Order it 海苔なし (without nori) and there is literally nothing else in it — this is the single safest, and arguably the best, thing to order at this shop. Ask for 海苔なし if you cannot confirm the nori is unseasoned.

items.en: Ume — Wakayama Kishu Nanko plum steeped in honey, so sour and sweet at once
items.note: Plum, salt and honey — no wheat. Honey means it is not vegan, and it is worth knowing that most Japanese umeboshi are plum, salt and shiso only; this shop's is a はちみつ漬け.

items.en: Nori tsukudani — seaweed cooked down slowly into a dark, sweet-salty paste, made by hand here
items.note: 佃煮 is by definition simmered in soy sauce and sugar. Wheat.

items.en: Takana — spicy mustard greens from a well-known Tsukiji pickler, stir-fried in oil; all crunch
items.note: 辛子高菜油炒め is usually pickled greens, chilli and sesame oil — but the seasoning almost always includes soy sauce. Ask.

items.en: Kombu — Hokkaido kelp, seasoned lightly so the kelp itself comes through
items.note: Seasoned kombu for onigiri is simmered in soy. Wheat.

items.en: Okaka — bonito flakes with soy, the definitive default filling
items.note: Soy sauce and dried fish. The shop notes it works well as the supporting half of a two-filling rice ball.

items.en: Salmon — the shop's number one seller, grilled in-house and flaked and boned by hand
items.note: The shop warns small bones may remain. Grilled salted salmon on its own has no wheat, but ask whether it is seasoned. Note: the oil-based fillings in this band come WITHOUT nori.

items.en: Mackerel — rich and oily, seasoned with salt and a little soy
items.note: The shop's own description names 少々の醤油 — a little soy sauce. Wheat, by the shop's own wording.

items.en: Mentaiko — chilli-cured pollack roe, sharp and salty
items.note: Mentaiko cures normally contain soy sauce, sake and sometimes wheat-derived seasoning. Ask.

items.en: Tarako — uncured cod roe, fine-grained and popping, milder than mentaiko
Shirasu — plump boiled whitebait, packed in generously, with a touch of soy for accent
items.note: The shop names 醤油 in the description.

items.en: Negitoro — minced fatty tuna with scallion, in a rice ball rather than on sushi
items.note: Negitoro is often pre-seasoned with soy. Ask.

items.en: Torotaku — negitoro with takuan pickled daikon chopped through it, for the contrast of soft and crunchy
items.note: 沢庵 is usually a salt-and-rice-bran pickle without soy, but commercial takuan often carries seasoning. Ask.

items.en: Egg yolk cured in the house soy marinade — dense and almost jam-like; the shop calls it tamago-kake-gohan you eat with your hands
items.note: 醤油ダレ — soy marinade, so wheat. It is also the filling the shop pairs with most others.

items.en: Tuna mayo — tuna given a Japanese seasoning then bound with mayonnaise; the children's favourite
items.note: 和風に味付け normally means soy and dashi. Mayonnaise is egg.

items.en: Salted kombu and bonito coated in sesame oil — a modern filling, and the shop is proud of it
items.note: 塩昆布 is simmered in soy; bonito is fish. Comes without nori, as all the oil fillings do.

items.en: 'The Suzuki family's shiso plum' — a plum pickle made only locally and handed down in one household; properly sour
items.note: Plum, salt and red shiso — the traditional three-ingredient umeboshi, with no soy and no honey. Together with the plain salt musubi, the most reliably safe filling here.

items.en: Minced meat soboro, cooked down sweet and salty
items.note: 甘辛く味付け means soy and sugar.

items.en: Salmon grilled in Saikyo miso from a specialist miso maker — sweet, and the miso melts into the fish
items.note: Saikyo miso is a rice-koji white miso, so often wheat-free — but the marinade normally carries mirin and sake and the grain base is not declared. Ask.

items.en: Chirimen sansho — tiny dried sardines simmered with sansho pepper, made in-house and seasoned strongly enough to carry a rice ball; numbing on the tongue
items.note: Simmered in soy. A Kyoto speciality, unusual in Asakusa.

items.en: Spam — griddled until the edges caramelise, glazed with teriyaki sauce and paired with soft egg
items.note: 照り焼きタレ is soy-based. Egg.

items.en: Stamina — pork seasoned hard with miso and onion, heavy on garlic with ginger behind it. The one to order when you need feeding
items.note: 味噌ベース with garlic; the miso grain base is undeclared and pork miso seasonings normally include soy.

items.en: Shirasu oil — whitebait, sesame oil and spring onion mixed through the rice rather than parcelled inside; the shop's quiet favourite
items.note: If it is only whitebait, sesame oil and negi it would be wheat-free — but the plain しらす filling is described as soy-accented, so ask about this one. No nori.

items.en: Eel — grilled until it puffs, glazed in the sweet-salty tare
items.note: 甘辛タレ is reduced soy and mirin. Wheat.

items.en: Sujiko — the whole membrane-bound sac of red salmon roe, richer and saltier than loose ikura, packed in by the mouthful
items.note: Sujiko is cured in salt or in a soy marinade depending on the maker. Ask which.

items.en: Salmon and salmon roe in one rice ball — the shop calls it the parent-and-child combination
items.section: おすすめ組み合わせ Recommended pairs
items.note: Two fillings costs +¥100 on any rice ball; these are the shop's own suggestions.

items.ja: 肉そぼろ✖︎卵黄しょうゆ漬
items.en: Sweet-salty minced meat wrapped around the cured egg yolk
items.section: おすすめ組み合わせ Recommended pairs

items.ja: しらす✖︎卵黄しょうゆ漬／ねぎとろ✖︎卵黄しょうゆ漬
items.en: Whitebait or minced fatty tuna against the cured yolk — ¥530 each
items.section: おすすめ組み合わせ Recommended pairs

items.en: Spicy mustard greens with cod roe — the Kyushu pairing
items.section: おすすめ組み合わせ Recommended pairs

items.en: Plum and kelp — the plainest and most Japanese of the pairs
items.section: おすすめ組み合わせ Recommended pairs
items.note: The kombu brings the soy.

items.en: The ultimate tonjiru — pork and vegetable soup built on a pork-bone stock simmered seven hours; the shop calls it its own headline dish, ahead of the rice balls
items.note: 豚汁 is finished with miso, grain base undeclared, and this one starts from a 秘伝 stock of unstated seasoning. Assume wheat.

items.en: Karaage marinated in the shop's secret tare
items.note: Flour coating, soy marinade, deep fryer.

items.en: A salted boiled egg — for when you want one more thing
items.note: The shop specifies 塩味 — salt-seasoned, not the usual soy-marinated ajitama. Egg, salt and water only.

items.ja: お新香（きゅうり／べったら漬け）
items.en: Pickles — cucumber or bettara-zuke, the sweet Tokyo daikon pickled in sake lees and rice koji. Either one on its own is fine
items.note: べったら漬け is a genuinely local Tokyo pickle (its own festival is held in Nihonbashi each October); it is koji and sake lees, not soy, though the lees route is worth a question.

tokyo_kyoto_uji_fujii_meien.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from the operator's own menu PDF, file-dated 2026-06, which is the current card; the first figure is pre-tax as printed, the figure in brackets is tax-included. Checked 2026-08-20. 6F of Tokyu Plaza Shibuya, 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00). The kakigori page is summer-only. The menu's own front page says: 食物アレルギーがご心配のお客様は、当店スタッフにお申し出ください — tell the staff about allergies.

items.ja: おばんざい小鉢3種（茶懐石膳）
items.en: Three-bowl obanzai tray — Kyoto home cooking in little dishes, with matcha-salt rice, red-miso soup, pickles and the day's Uji tea. Choose your main: yuzu-pepper grilled salted chicken, or mackerel with mentaiko
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: おばんざいの煮物・出汁巻きは醤油・味醂＝小麦の可能性大。赤出汁は豆味噌なら小麦不使用だが要確認。鰹だし使用でビーガン不可。Simmered obanzai almost always carries soy; the dashi is bonito.

items.ja: おばんざい小鉢5種（茶懐石膳）
items.en: Five-bowl obanzai tray — the chef's pick of five, balanced across meat, fish and vegetable, with matcha-salt rice, red-miso soup, pickles and Uji tea
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: 同上。品目が増える分、醤油・出汁の使用箇所も増える。要確認。

items.ja: おばんざい小鉢9種（茶懐石膳）
items.en: Nine-bowl obanzai tray — the full spread, laid out in a compartmented box: nine seasonal small dishes including a summer eel course and the popular mains, plus rice, soup, pickles and Uji tea
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: うなぎの蒲焼＝醤油ダレ（小麦）。他の小鉢も醤油使用の可能性大。

items.en: Beef cutlet set — a thick breadcrumbed beef cutlet served rare on a wire rack, with obanzai side dishes, matcha-salt rice, red-miso soup, pickles and Uji tea
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、共用フライヤー。Panko crust, shared fryer.

items.ja: 鰹のたたき御膳（夏の味わい）
items.en: Seared bonito set — summer's katsuo seared and sliced, dressed with vinegar and aromatic vegetables to cut the richness, with obanzai, matcha-salt rice, red-miso soup, pickles and Uji tea
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: たたきのポン酢・土佐醤油に小麦。The ponzu or tosa-joyu dressing is wheat soy.

items.en: Cold cha-soba with tempura — bright green tea-kneaded soba noodles, served cold, with a plate of prawn and vegetable tempura, matcha salt and Uji tea
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: 茶そばは小麦粉とそば粉のブレンド＝小麦。天ぷら衣も小麦。つゆも醤油。Cha-soba is a wheat-and-buckwheat blend; three separate sources of gluten here.

items.en: Cold cha-soba — the noodles on their own, with dipping broth, condiments and Uji tea. Fragrant with matcha rather than merely coloured by it
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: 茶そばは小麦粉入り。つゆも醤油＝小麦。

items.ja: 香味野菜の冷やし豚汁（夏の一汁一菜）
items.en: Chilled pork-and-vegetable miso soup — the winter staple served cold for summer, loaded with aromatic vegetables, as a one-soup-one-dish set with rice and Uji tea
items.section: お食事 Meals（すべて本日の宇治茶付き / all served with the day's Uji tea）
items.note: 味噌が麦味噌なら小麦。豚肉・鰹だし使用でビーガン不可。If the miso is barley miso (麦味噌) this contains gluten — ask which miso.

items.ja: 藤井茶園の宇治茶と小さな甘味3種
items.romaji: Uji tea with three small sweets
items.en: Uji tea and three small sweets — matcha basque cheesecake, matcha warabimochi and a brûlée, with seasonal fruit as a palate cleanser, and your choice of sencha or thin matcha (Kawatake). The composition changes with the season
items.section: 甘味 Sweets（すべて宇治茶付き / all served with Uji tea）
items.note: バスクチーズケーキは薄力粉またはコーンスターチ使用の可能性、ブリュレは卵・乳。わらび餅はわらび粉なら小麦不使用。乳・卵使用でビーガン不可。

items.ja: 濃い宇治抹茶ソフトクリーム
items.en: Strong Uji matcha soft serve — piled high with matcha syrup, Hokkaido azuki, shiratama rice dumplings and mugwort dango. The densest matcha thing on the menu; comes with Uji tea
items.section: 甘味 Sweets（すべて宇治茶付き / all served with Uji tea）
items.note: ソフトクリーム＝乳製品。白玉・よもぎ団子は米粉で小麦不使用だが、抹茶蜜と製造ラインを要確認。Dairy, so not vegan; the dumplings are rice.

items.ja: 抹茶のバスクチーズケーキ
items.en: Matcha Basque cheesecake — burnt-top, wobbly-centred, cut in a wedge with cream; comes with Uji tea
items.section: 甘味 Sweets（すべて宇治茶付き / all served with Uji tea）
items.note: バスクチーズケーキは粉を使わないレシピもあるが、薄力粉・コーンスターチ入りが一般的。必ず確認を。乳・卵使用。Some Basque cheesecakes are flourless — this one needs asking.

items.ja: 宇治抹茶のスコーン 2個 果実のジャム添え
items.romaji: Uji matcha scones with fruit jam
items.en: Two Uji matcha scones with fruit jam and whipped cream — the shop's takeaway-friendly sweet; comes with Uji tea
items.section: 甘味 Sweets（すべて宇治茶付き / all served with Uji tea）
items.note: スコーン＝小麦粉。乳製品使用。Scones are wheat flour.

items.ja: 抹茶と京生麩の冷やしぜんざい
items.romaji: matcha and Kyoto nama-fu chilled zenzai
items.en: Chilled zenzai with matcha and Kyoto nama-fu — cold sweet bean soup with the wheat-gluten cakes Kyoto is known for. Only for diners taking a meal
items.section: お食事の方への甘味 Sweets for diners（宇治茶はつきません / no tea included）
items.note: 生麩は小麦グルテンそのもの。絶対に不可。麩 (fu) IS pure wheat gluten — never eat this if you are avoiding gluten.

items.ja: 抹茶のソフトクリーム（お食事の方）
items.en: Matcha soft serve at the diners' price — the cheaper version of the sweet, for people who have eaten a meal. No tea included
items.section: お食事の方への甘味 Sweets for diners（宇治茶はつきません / no tea included）
items.note: 乳製品。抹茶蜜・トッピングの原材料は要確認。

items.ja: 抹茶バスクチーズケーキ（お食事の方）
items.en: Matcha Basque cheesecake at the diners' price. No tea included
items.section: お食事の方への甘味 Sweets for diners（宇治茶はつきません / no tea included）
items.note: 小麦粉・コーンスターチの有無を要確認。乳・卵使用。

items.en: Thin matcha, Kawatake — whisked to order. The shop notes this cultivar carries little of matcha's astringency, so it drinks round and mellow. Comes with a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 抹茶自体は茶葉のみで小麦不使用・植物性。ただし添えられるお茶菓子（干菓子・練り切り等）に小麦・卵が入る場合あり。The tea is fine; ask about the sweet that comes with it.

items.ja: シングルオリジン あさひ（お抹茶）
items.en: Single-origin matcha, Asahi cultivar — Fujii's own single-varietal leaf; creamy, barely astringent, with a strong sweetness and aroma. Whisked to order, with a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 抹茶は茶葉のみ。お茶菓子の原材料を要確認。

items.en: Gyokuro — shade-grown, the top grade of Japanese green tea; thick, sweet and deeply umami. With a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 茶葉のみ。お茶菓子を要確認。

items.en: Sencha — mid-grade leaf, the everyday one: gentle sweetness, a pleasant astringency, clean finish. With a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 茶葉のみ。お茶菓子を要確認。

items.en: Genmaicha — green tea blended with roasted brown rice; toasty, light, and comparatively low in caffeine. With a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 玄米茶の「玄米」は米であり大麦ではないため小麦不使用。麦茶と混同しないこと。お茶菓子は要確認。Genmaicha is RICE, not barley — do not confuse it with 麦茶.

items.en: Matcha genmaicha — genmaicha with matcha stirred through: rich but still refined, with the toasted-rice aroma rising over it. With a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 米と茶葉のみ。お茶菓子を要確認。

items.en: Karigane — stem tea, brewed only from the stalks of the new shoots; a distinctive fresh aroma and sweetness. Also called kukicha. With a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 茶葉（茎）のみ。お茶菓子を要確認。

items.en: Hojicha — roasted green tea, no bitterness or astringency, all toasted aroma against a sweet finish. With a tea sweet
items.section: 宇治茶・お抹茶 Uji tea（すべてお茶菓子つき / all served with a tea sweet）
items.note: 茶葉のみ。お茶菓子を要確認。

items.en: Matcha latte — made so the bitterness of the matcha stays in the foreground rather than being buried by the milk
items.note: 牛乳使用でビーガン不可。抹茶と牛乳のみなら小麦不使用だがシロップの有無を要確認。

items.ja: 宇治茶「河武」の抹茶ラテ [HOT/ICE]
items.en: Kawatake matcha latte — built on the mellow, low-astringency matcha
items.note: 乳製品使用。

items.ja: シングルオリジン「あさひ」の抹茶ラテ [HOT/ICE]
items.en: Single-origin Asahi matcha latte — one cultivar only, so the sweetness and aroma push right through the milk. The most expensive drink on the list
items.note: 乳製品使用。

items.ja: 藤井茶園のほうじ茶ラテ [HOT/ICE]
items.en: Hojicha latte — slowly extracted roasted tea with milk; the toasty one
items.note: 乳製品使用。

items.ja: グリンティーレモネード
items.en: Green tea lemonade — green tea cut with lemon, non-alcoholic and sharp
items.note: 茶・レモン・砂糖で小麦不使用と考えられるが、シロップの原材料を要確認。植物性。

items.ja: 柚子煎茶トニック（ノンアルコール）
items.en: Yuzu and sencha with tonic water — non-alcoholic, bitter and citrus
items.note: 茶・柚子・トニックで小麦不使用と考えられるが要確認。植物性。

items.en: Asahi Premium Jukusen, small bottle
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails

items.ja: スパークリングワイン
items.en: Sparkling wine by the glass
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ぶどうが原料で通常小麦不使用。清澄剤に卵白・ゼラチンを使う銘柄はビーガン不可。

items.ja: アサヒ ドライゼロ
items.en: Asahi Dry Zero — non-alcoholic beer
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ノンアルコールでも原料は麦芽＝グルテン。Alcohol-free but still made from barley malt.

items.en: Matcha beer — the house original: matcha whisked into beer, poured with a green head
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ビールベース＝麦芽。絶対に不可。Beer-based — never gluten-free.

items.ja: 抹茶スパークリングワイン
items.en: Matcha sparkling wine — matcha in the flute, served like a green champagne cocktail
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ワインと抹茶。通常小麦不使用だが清澄剤の確認を。

items.en: Matcha highball — matcha with shochu and soda
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ベースが麦焼酎の場合は不可。何の焼酎かを必ず確認。Ask which shochu — barley shochu is not GF.

items.ja: 本日の美味しいお茶ハイ
items.en: Tea highball of the day — whichever Uji tea the counter is pouring, made long with shochu
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類を要確認。

items.en: Sencha gin and tonic — Fujii's leaf steeped into the gin itself, then lengthened with tonic. The shop's own infusion, made nowhere else

items.ja: ほうじ茶ジントニック
items.en: Hojicha gin and tonic — the roasted-tea version, darker and nuttier
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails

items.en: Gyokuro gin and tonic — the sweetest, most umami-heavy of the four infusions
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails
items.note: ジンの原料穀物を要確認。

items.ja: 抹茶玄米茶ジントニック
items.en: Matcha genmaicha gin and tonic — toasted rice and matcha through the gin
items.section: お酒・お茶とお酒・ティーテイル Alcohol & tea cocktails

items.en: Uji matcha kakigori — shaved ice under the house-made matcha syrup with azuki. The plainest and best of the summer ices; comes with a choice of Uji tea
items.section: kakigori 季節の至福（夏限定 summer only・宇治茶付き）

items.en: Matcha and strawberry kakigori — both house syrups over the ice, with azuki
items.section: kakigori 季節の至福（夏限定 summer only・宇治茶付き）

items.ja: 宇治抹茶ミルクマスカルポーネ（かき氷）
items.en: Uji matcha milk mascarpone kakigori — matcha syrup, azuki, wasanbon milk sauce and a cap of mascarpone cream

items.ja: 抹茶エスプーマ（かき氷）
items.en: Matcha espuma kakigori — matcha syrup and azuki under an aerated matcha foam
items.section: kakigori 季節の至福（夏限定 summer only・宇治茶付き）
items.note: エスプーマに乳・卵白を使う場合ビーガン不可。要確認。

items.ja: 抹茶ミルクエスプーマかけ（かき氷）

items.section: kakigori 季節の至福（夏限定 summer only・宇治茶付き）
items.note: ミルクソース＝乳製品。

items.ja: 抹茶といちごマスカルポーネクリーム（かき氷）
items.en: Matcha and strawberry mascarpone kakigori — two syrups, wasanbon milk sauce and mascarpone cream
items.section: kakigori 季節の至福（夏限定 summer only・宇治茶付き）
items.note: マスカルポーネ＝乳製品。

items.en: Strawberry milk kakigori — strawberry syrup, wasanbon milk sauce and mascarpone cream. The one without matcha
items.section: kakigori 季節の至福（夏限定 summer only・宇治茶付き）
items.note: 乳製品使用。

items.en: Anno sweet potato kakigori — sweet potato syrup, wasanbon milk sauce, brown-sugar jelly, sweet potato cream and candied Naruto kintoki potato
