items.note: 自家製ケフィアの培地（乳か豆乳か）が未記載。The shop does not say whether its kefir is dairy-based — ask.

items.ja: ジンジャーアップルジュース
items.en: Apple, ginger juice, honey and apple juice
items.note: はちみつ入り（店の材料表記）。The shop's ingredient line includes honey.

items.en: Apple, carrot, apple vinegar and beet sugar — the shop lists it at 89 kcal
items.note: 果物・野菜・りんご酢・甜菜糖のみ。Fruit, vegetable, cider vinegar and beet sugar.

items.en: Organic kiwi and lemon juice topped with Perrier
items.note: 果汁と炭酸水のみ。Juice and sparkling water.

items.en: Perrier sparkling mineral water
items.note: 炭酸水のみ。Sparkling water.

items.en: Organic beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。オーガニックであってもビールは大麦。Organic or not, beer is barley malt.

items.en: Corona
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Kahlua with soy milk instead of dairy
items.note: 豆乳使用と店が明記。The shop states soy milk.

items.ja: イタリア直送有機ワイン（ボトル）
items.en: Organic Italian wine shipped direct — the list runs from a Lambrusco Reggiano rosato to a Franciacorta Brut DOCG
items.note: ワイン自体に小麦なし。清澄剤（卵白等）の使用は銘柄次第。No wheat in wine; fining agents vary by producer.

items.ja: ランブルスコ レッジャーノ DOC ロザート セミセッコ（グラス）
items.en: Sparkling rosé Lambrusco by the glass — the shop's note: 'like biting into a cherry'
items.note: 清澄剤未記載。Fining agent not stated.

items.ja: ベッレリーベ ガルダ ピノビアンコ D.O.C.（グラス）
items.en: Lombardy Pinot Bianco by the glass — lemon and white flowers, crisp
items.note: 清澄剤未記載。Fining agent not stated.

items.ja: オッフィーダ ペコリーノ D.O.P. BIO（グラス）
items.en: Organic Marche Pecorino white by the glass — delicate, faintly sweet finish
items.note: BIO表記だがヴィーガン認証ではない。Certified organic is not the same as vegan-fined.

tokyo_torisoba_ramen_tonari.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from a full-resolution photograph of the shop's own street A-board dated 2025/11, with the item names cross-checked against the shop's Tabelog item list; a 2026/07 photograph of the same board shows the identical printed panels with only the chalked daily specials changed, so the prices below were still standing in July 2026. Address 渋谷区円山町14-3 日興パレスビル渋谷 1F, eight counter stools only, no reservations, 12:00–21:00 and they close when the soup runs out. Closed Sundays and public holidays. The chalkboard at the top of the board carries whatever limited bowl is running that week — 2025/11 had 冷やし辛味噌鶏そば ¥1,000 and 秋刀魚のコンフィの塩ラーメン ¥1,600; 2026/07 had 冷やし担々鶏そば ¥1,100 and 真鯛とタコのチリトマトラーメン ¥1,600. Expect a different pair whenever you go.

items.en: The house bowl — a clear golden chicken broth seasoned with white soy sauce, sweet with chicken fat, no MSG, topped with a soft slow-cooked chicken chashu
items.note: 白醤油は小麦の比率がむしろ高い醤油。中華麺も小麦。White soy sauce is if anything MORE wheat-heavy than ordinary soy sauce, and the noodle is wheat.

items.en: Dark-soy chicken soba with dried sardine in the broth — the sharper, saltier of the two soy bowls
items.note: 濃口醤油＝小麦、麺も小麦。Dark soy sauce is wheat-brewed; wheat noodle.

items.en: Salt-seasoned chicken soba lifted with yuzu peel — the most fragrant bowl on the board and a regular reviewers' favourite
items.note: 塩ダレでも中華麺は小麦、塩ダレ自体に醤油が入ることも多い。Salt-based tare, but the noodle is still wheat and shio tare commonly contains some soy.

items.en: Soy chicken soba with pork back-fat floated on top — the richer, heavier option
items.note: 醤油・小麦麺。Soy sauce and wheat noodle.

items.en: Spicy red chicken-paitan soba — the cloudy, emulsified chicken broth with chilli
items.note: 辣油・味噌ダレの原材料未記載、麺は小麦。Chilli and miso components not itemised; wheat noodle regardless.

items.ja: 牡蠣ワンタンと青菜の旨塩そば
items.romaji: kaki wonton to aona no umashio soba
items.en: Salt soba with oyster wontons and greens — reviewers single out the oyster wontons as the thing to order here
items.note: ワンタンの皮は小麦、麺も小麦。Wonton skins are wheat, as is the noodle.

items.ja: 牡蠣と煮干しの白湯つけ麺
items.romaji: kaki to niboshi no paitan tsukemen
items.en: Dipping noodles in a thick oyster-and-dried-sardine paitan
items.note: つけ汁のとろみと麺の双方に小麦。Wheat noodle, and thickened dipping broth.

items.en: Oyster ramen
items.note: 麺・タレとも小麦。Wheat noodle and wheat-based tare.

items.en: Mapo noodles with oysters — the most expensive bowl on the printed board
items.note: 麻婆の豆板醤・甜麺醤はともに小麦を含むのが通例。Both doubanjiang and tianmianjiang normally contain wheat, on top of the wheat noodle.

items.ja: 冷やしパクチーあえそば
items.en: Chilled soupless noodles tossed with coriander
items.section: あえそば・ご飯 Mixed noodles and rice
items.note: 麺は小麦、あえダレの原材料未記載。Wheat noodle; the dressing is not itemised.

items.en: Small char siu rice bowl to go alongside
items.section: あえそば・ご飯 Mixed noodles and rice
items.note: チャーシューの煮汁は醤油。The chashu braise is soy-based.

items.en: Plain rice — order it to soak up the last of the broth
items.section: あえそば・ご飯 Mixed noodles and rice
items.note: 白飯のみ。Plain rice, nothing added.

items.en: Marinated soft-boiled egg
items.note: 醤油ダレ漬け。Soy-marinated.

items.en: Extra char siu
items.note: 煮汁は醤油。Soy braise.

items.en: Extra oyster wontons
items.note: 皮は小麦。Wheat wrappers.

items.en: Extra coriander
items.note: 生の香草のみ。Fresh herb only.

items.en: Two extra oysters
items.note: 下処理・味付けが未記載。How the oysters are prepared is not stated.

items.en: Large portion, or a second helping of noodles
items.note: 小麦麺の増量。More wheat noodle.

items.ja: 日替わり黒板メニュー

items.note: 内容は毎回変わるが、いずれも中華麺（小麦）を使用。Whatever is chalked up, it is served on the same wheat noodle.

tokyo_spice_curry_hachiwan_jim.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Taken from the shop's own 神保町店 page and the chain menu block on hachiwan-curry.com, read 2026-08-20. Address on the branch page is 〒101-0065 東京都千代田区西神田2-5-2 Tasビル1F, 11:00–20:30 — matching the Jimbocho record. The two named curries are the branch's current line-up and rotate; the 店主の気まぐれカリー is a chef's-whim slot that changes. HOW IT WORKS: you order and pay at the till (curry + rice choice, plus any hot snack or drink), then take your plate to the achar buffet and help yourself to as many of the fermented vegetable side dishes as you like — the buffet is included, not extra. A student discount is offered and takeaway is available. NOTE the 豊洲千客万来 branch has no buffet, and as of 2026-08-18 it has been relaunched as a スパイスカツカリー (breaded-cutlet) shop — that is a different branch and its cutlets would not be gluten-free.

items.ja: 牛肉ときのこの焦がし味噌カリー（1種盛り）
items.romaji: gyuniku to kinoko no kogashi-miso curry (1 curry)
items.en: Beef and mushroom curry in scorched miso — one curry on the plate, achar buffet included
items.note: 店は「小麦粉を使わず、野菜とスパイスの旨みで仕上げたグルテンフリーカリー」と自ら明記。ただしこの一皿だけは味噌を使い、味噌の種別（麦味噌かどうか）はサイトに記載がない。The shop states in its own words that it uses no wheat flour and calls its curry gluten-free — but this particular dish is built on miso and the site does not say which miso, so barley miso cannot be ruled out. Ask for this one specifically.

items.ja: サバとカツオだしのココナッツカリー（1種盛り）
items.romaji: saba to katsuo-dashi no coconut curry (1 curry)
items.en: Mackerel and bonito-dashi coconut curry — one curry on the plate, achar buffet included
items.note: 店の公式表記「小麦粉を使わず、野菜とスパイスの旨みで仕上げたグルテンフリーカリー」に基づく。The shop's own site states it uses no wheat flour and finishes the curry on vegetables and spice alone. Fish and bonito stock, so not vegan.

items.ja: 店主の気まぐれカリー（1種盛り）
items.en: The owner's whim curry — changes with his mood, +¥100 on top of the standard price
items.note: 内容が日替わりのため個別確認が必要。店の基本方針は小麦粉不使用。The base policy is no wheat flour, but the contents change daily so this one has to be asked about.

items.en: Two curries side by side on one plate, achar buffet included — the way to try the pair
items.note: どの2種を選ぶかによる。味噌カリーを含む場合は上記の注意点が適用。Depends which two you pick; if the miso curry is one of them, its caveat applies.

items.ja: アチャールビュッフェ
items.en: The achar buffet — Indian-style fermented vegetable and spice side dishes, laid out to be combined freely with your curry. Included in the curry price, refill as often as you like. The shop frames it on four axes: heat, sourness, aroma and texture
items.note: 日替わりで内容が変わり、個々の副菜の材料は公開されていない。The line-up changes and no per-item ingredient list is published — this is the part of the meal to ask about, since a shared buffet also means shared serving spoons.

items.en: Hachiwan box — the takeaway/office-delivery boxed version; group and corporate orders taken by arrangement
items.note: 中身は日により異なる。店の基本方針は小麦粉不使用だが、箱の内容は未公開。Contents vary; the no-wheat-flour policy is the shop's, but the box contents are not itemised online.

tokyo_asakusa_monja_okonomiyak.price_note: Prices approximate — may change, and these are TAX-EXCLUSIVE: the list carries 「※表示価格は税抜きです」, so add 10% at the till. Item list is the shop's 公式 Tabelog registration, 更新日 2024/11/06 — over a year old, so treat the figures as indicative. The English street A-board photographed 2025/10 (¥4,000 for 2 drinks + 2 dishes) is current. The shop's own domain asakusa-ponchan.com no longer serves a site (HTTP 404). Tabelog's own おすすめ panel disagrees with its item list on two dishes — 明太子スペシャルもんじゃ appears at both ¥1,550 and ¥1,000, and 基本のお好み焼き at both ¥750 and ¥550; the section-list figure is used below.

items.en: Basic monja — cabbage, spring onion, dried squid, tempura crumbs, fried pork fat and dried shrimp, cooked by you on the griddle
items.section: もんじゃ＆お好み焼き Monja & okonomiyaki
items.note: Monjayaki is a loose 小麦粉 (wheat flour) batter thinned with dashi or Worcestershire-style sauce, and the listed base already includes 揚げ玉 (wheat tempura crumbs) and 油かす (fried pork fat). Wheat and pork; there is no version of this dish that is safe for either diet.

items.ja: 基本のお好み焼き 玉子入り
items.en: Basic okonomiyaki with egg — cabbage, spring onion, dried squid, tempura crumbs, pork fat, pickled ginger
items.section: もんじゃ＆お好み焼き Monja & okonomiyaki
items.note: Wheat-flour batter, egg, 揚げ玉 (wheat) and 油かす (pork). Okonomiyaki sauce is a Worcestershire-type sauce and okonomiyaki mayonnaise is egg. Tabelog's おすすめ panel prices this at ¥750; the section list says ¥550.

items.ja: 明太子スペシャルもんじゃ
items.en: Spicy-cod-roe special monja — the shop's headline dish
items.note: Wheat batter plus 明太子 (marinated pollack roe, itself normally cured with soy sauce and mirin). Tabelog's おすすめ panel lists ¥1,550 for the same name — check at the counter.

items.ja: きのこスペシャルもんじゃ
items.en: Mushroom special monja
items.note: Mushrooms sound plant-based but the monja base itself is wheat batter with dried squid, tempura crumbs and pork fat.

items.en: Mapo-tofu monja
items.note: Wheat batter; mapo tofu is built on 豆板醤 and 甜麺醤, both of which are wheat-fermented pastes, and contains minced pork.

items.ja: 梅ジソ ササミもんじゃ
items.en: Plum, perilla and chicken-breast monja
items.note: Wheat batter; chicken.

items.en: Mixed monja — the loaded version
items.note: Wheat batter with seafood and meat.

items.en: Yakisoba — fried wheat noodles, toppings available
items.note: Yakisoba noodles are wheat, and yakisoba sauce is a Worcestershire-style sauce. Also on the English street board.

items.en: Salt-seasoned yakisoba
items.note: Salt instead of sauce, but the noodles are still wheat.

items.en: Yaki-udon — fried udon noodles
items.note: Listed on the shop's English street board (Yaki-Udon, 'Fride Udon') but not in the Tabelog price list, so no price is recorded here rather than guessed. Udon is wheat.

items.en: Cucumber sticks with moromi miso
items.note: もろみ味噌 is a chunky fermented paste made from soybeans AND barley or wheat koji — a gluten grain by construction. Usually plant-only, but some versions add bonito.

items.en: Cucumber sticks with pickled-plum paste
items.note: Cucumber and umeboshi paste — plant-only in principle and no wheat ingredient, but commercial 梅肉 is often extended with bonito (かつお梅) or with mirin. Ask.

items.en: Mr Han's kimchi
items.note: Kimchi in Japan almost always contains 魚醤 or salted shrimp/anchovy — not vegan. Gochujang, if present, is usually made with wheat flour, so gluten is a real question too.

items.en: Chilled sliced tomato
items.note: Plain cut tomato — the only thing on this menu that is plant-only by construction. Gluten 'ask' rather than 'gf' because it is prepared in a kitchen whose entire output is wheat batter, and it is sometimes served with a mayonnaise or dressing on the side.

items.en: Ume-suisho — shark cartilage with plum paste
items.note: Shark cartilage dressed with plum, soy sauce and mirin — soy is wheat; fish.

items.en: A whole pickled cucumber on a stick
items.note: Whole-cucumber pickles are brined in salt, or in a soy/dashi brine. Which one is not stated.

items.en: 'Tanuki' tofu — cold tofu with tempura crumbs
items.note: たぬき means topped with 揚げ玉 — deep-fried wheat batter crumbs. Also dressed with soy sauce and usually bonito flakes.

items.en: Raw green peppers with meat miso
items.note: Minced pork in a miso sauce — meat, and miso plus the usual soy/mirin seasoning.

items.en: Cabbage tossed with salted kombu
items.note: 塩昆布 is kombu simmered in soy sauce and mirin before drying — soy is wheat. Kombu itself is plant-based, but commercial 塩昆布 sometimes carries bonito extract.

items.en: Date-brand chicken white liver
items.note: Liver, almost always simmered or dressed in a soy-and-mirin sauce.

items.ja: バリバリキャベツ＆肉みそ
items.en: Crunchy raw cabbage with meat miso
items.note: The cabbage is raw, but the dip is pork in miso.

items.ja: バリバリピーマン＆肉みそ
items.en: Crunchy raw green peppers with meat miso

items.note: The shop calls this its 名物. Battera is pressed cured mackerel over vinegared rice under a sheet of 白板昆布. The cure is salt + vinegar, so it can be wheat-free — but many shops add a little soy or mirin to the marinade and to the kombu sheet. Ask before eating; the shop publishes no allergen list.

items.en: Squid tentacles, a small drinking snack

Taken from the shop's own trilingual (JA/EN/ZH) counter card photographed 2026/01, cross-checked against the 2024/09 ticket-machine photo (every dish had risen ¥10 since then, e.g. 濃厚つけ麺 ¥1,100 → ¥1,110). Allergen facts are from the operator Oishes' own 28-allergen chart for つけ麺つじ田 (allergy_table_hit.pdf, page 2).

items.en: Rich broth tsukemen — dipping noodles in thick pork-bone-and-fish broth, the house original; served with sudachi citrus and black shichimi
items.note: Shop's own allergen chart marks 小麦 (wheat) and 卵 (egg). Wheat noodles; broth is pork bone + fish (katsuo/niboshi) with soy tare. Oishes states the noodle and soup factory also produces wheat, egg and dairy products, and all dishes share cooking equipment.

items.en: Rich broth tsukemen with a seasoned soft-boiled egg
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart. Wheat noodles; the ajitama is marinated in soy-sauce tare (wheat).

items.en: Special rich broth tsukemen — the loaded version, with egg and extra char siu
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart. Wheat noodles and soy-braised pork.

items.en: Rich broth tsukemen topped with pulled (shredded) special char siu pork
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart. Wheat noodles; char siu is braised in soy sauce.

items.ja: 濃厚チャーシューつけ麺
items.en: Rich broth tsukemen with sliced char siu pork — marked RECOMMEND on the card
items.note: Wheat noodles plus soy-braised char siu. Not on the allergen chart by this name, but built on the same 濃厚つけ麺 base which is marked 小麦・卵.

items.en: Rich broth ramen — the same thick pork-and-fish soup served as a hot noodle bowl
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's own chart. Wheat noodles, soy tare.

items.en: Rich broth ramen with seasoned soft-boiled egg
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart.

items.en: Special rich broth ramen — loaded, with egg and extra pork
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart.

items.en: Rich broth ramen with pulled special char siu pork
items.note: 小麦・卵 on the shop's chart.

items.ja: 濃厚チャーシューらーめん
items.en: Rich broth ramen with sliced char siu pork
items.note: Wheat noodles and soy-braised pork; same 濃厚らーめん base, marked 小麦・卵.

items.en: Plain white rice
items.note: The one dish with NO allergen marked at all on つじ田's own 28-allergen chart — plain steamed rice, no soy sauce. Still 'ask' rather than 'gf' because the same chart's header states the kitchen cannot exclude allergen ingredients and all dishes share cooking equipment with wheat noodles; a rice bowl handed across a tsukemen counter is a cross-contact risk. Vegan 'ask' only for handling, the rice itself is plain.

items.en: Small rice / rice refill
items.note: Same plain rice in a smaller bowl (the ticket machine calls it 替え飯). Unmarked on the allergen chart; same shared-kitchen caveat as 白ごはん.

items.en: Rice with pickled leaf-mustard greens
items.note: Marked 小麦 (wheat) on the shop's own allergen chart — the takana seasoning carries soy sauce. Also marked ごま/大豆/豚肉 further along the row.

items.en: Char siu pork rice bowl
items.note: Marked 小麦 on the shop's own chart — the pork is braised in wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Japanese greens topping (spinach and komatsuna)
items.note: Plain blanched greens; not separately listed on the allergen chart, so no per-item evidence either way. Ask whether they are dressed or blanched in the noodle water.

items.ja: 佐賀県有明海産 一番摘み海苔
items.en: First-harvest nori seaweed from the Ariake Sea, Saga Prefecture
items.note: Plain dried nori sheets by the shop's own description; nori itself is naturally free of gluten and animal products, but the shop publishes no ingredient line for it and it is served into a wheat-noodle bowl.

items.en: Wood-ear mushroom
items.note: No allergen line published for this topping. Wood-ear is usually rehydrated and seasoned; seasoning normally means soy sauce, so ask.

items.en: Chopped scallion
items.note: Raw scallion. Not separately listed on the allergen chart; the risk is the shared prep surface, not the ingredient.

items.en: Sudachi citrus — squeezed into the noodles a third of the way through, per the shop's printed 'how to eat' card
items.note: A cut citrus fruit. No allergen line published. The shop's counter card (つじ田つけ麺流儀) instructs squeezing it over the noodles at the one-third mark.

items.en: Seasoned bamboo shoots
items.note: Menma is simmered in a soy-based seasoning as a rule; the shop publishes no per-topping allergen line, so treat as soy/wheat unless the counter says otherwise.

items.en: Seasoned soft-boiled egg
items.note: Egg, and marinated in soy-sauce tare (wheat). 卵 is marked wherever this appears on the shop's chart.

items.en: One slice of char siu pork
items.note: Soy-braised pork — wheat via the braising liquid; the チャーシューごはん made from it is marked 小麦 on the shop's chart.

items.en: Pulled special char siu pork
items.note: Same soy-braised pork, shredded. Wheat via soy sauce.

items.en: Tsukemen, large noodle portion (surcharge)
items.note: More wheat noodles. From the shop's ticket machine.

items.en: Tsukemen, extra-large noodle portion (surcharge)
items.note: More wheat noodles. From the shop's ticket machine.

items.en: Canned beer
items.note: Beer is brewed from barley malt — a gluten grain — so never gluten-free.

items.en: Black oolong tea (bottled)
items.note: Oolong is a tea leaf, not a grain — unlike 麦茶 it carries no barley. Bottled product, so the brand's own label is the authority; the shop publishes none.

tokyo_nikumaru_sakaba_suidobas.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. All tax-included, from the shop's own HotPepper listing (food page last updated 2026/04/10, drink page 2024/03/22) and its own owst.jp site. Address confirmed as 千代田区神田三崎町2-19-7 大庄ビル3F, Suidobashi Stn 1 min. Open Tue–Sun 14:00–23:30, closed Mondays. The shop publishes no allergen chart, so every gluten call below is read off the dish name and Japanese izakaya practice, not off a shop statement.

items.en: 'Cheese-toro' — melted cheese over minced fatty tuna or beef, the house speed-snack
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Dairy. Composition not published; izakaya versions are finished with a soy-based tare, so ask.

items.en: Fried chicken karaage
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Karaage is marinated in soy sauce and dusted in wheat flour or a flour/potato-starch blend, then fried in oil shared with breaded items on this menu.

items.en: Fried chicken cartilage
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Same soy marinade, same flour dusting, same shared fryer.

items.en: Fried chicken wings
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Nagoya-style wings are fried then glazed with a soy-and-mirin tare — wheat both ways.

items.en: Salted green soybeans in the pod
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Boiled and salted soybeans — normally nothing but beans, water and salt, which makes this one of the few plant-only dishes here. No allergen statement is published and the kitchen deep-fries wheat, so ask.

items.ja: やみつきガーリックシュリンプ
items.en: 'Addictive' garlic shrimp
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Prawns. Garlic-butter shrimp need not contain wheat, but Japanese versions are frequently dusted in flour before the pan — ask.

items.en: Rolled dashi omelette
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Egg — not vegan. The dashi in a commercial dashimaki is almost always 白だし or めんつゆ, which are soy-sauce based and therefore wheat, and bonito besides. A classic dish that looks safe and is not.

items.en: Fried octopus
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Flour-dusted and fried; soy in the marinade.

items.en: Stir-fried cabbage
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Cabbage in a pan. Almost every Japanese stir-fry is seasoned with soy sauce and many use a dashi or oyster-sauce base — ask what goes in before treating it as either.

items.en: Breaded fried salmon
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: フライ means panko breadcrumbs — wheat — and it comes with tartare or a wheat-containing sauce.

items.ja: サーモンカルパッチョ
items.en: Salmon carpaccio (quick-menu portion)
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Raw fish. Carpaccio dressing here is undocumented; Japanese versions often use a soy-and-olive-oil dressing, so ask.

items.en: Tuna carpaccio
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Raw fish; dressing undocumented, likely soy-based.

items.en: Fried mehikari (greeneye) — small whole deep-water fish
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Flour-dusted, shared fryer.

items.ja: 旨辛ささみスティック
items.en: Spicy chicken-tender sticks
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Battered or breaded fried chicken with a spicy sauce — wheat in both the coating and, typically, the sauce.

items.en: Fried cheese wontons
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Wonton wrappers are wheat dough. Dairy filling.

items.en: Salted cucumber sticks
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Cucumber and salt. Some izakaya salt-cucumber preparations use a dashi or kombu-cha seasoning — kombu-cha powder is fine, a bonito or soy dressing is not. Ask.

items.ja: 海老とブロッコリーのアヒージョ
items.en: Prawn and broccoli in garlic oil
items.note: Prawns. Ajillo itself is oil, garlic and chilli, but it is served with bread to mop up — ask them to leave the bread off, and ask whether the same oil pot is used for anything floured.

items.ja: レバーパテとバケット
items.en: Liver pâté with baguette
items.note: Baguette is wheat; pâté is liver, butter and usually brandy.

items.ja: 生ハムとトマトのブルスケッタ
items.en: Prosciutto and tomato bruschetta
items.note: Bruschetta is toasted bread — wheat — with cured pork on top.

items.en: Cabbage with anchovy
items.note: Anchovy — fish, so not vegan. No wheat in the name; the pan and the seasoning are unstated.

items.ja: 海老とトマトのアヒージョ
items.en: Prawn and tomato in garlic oil
items.note: Prawns; served with bread as standard.

items.en: Garlic toast
items.note: Bread — wheat. Usually buttered, so dairy too.

items.en: Assorted prosciutto and cured hams
items.note: Cured pork. Dry-cured ham is normally just pork and salt, but the plate arrives with bread or grissini as standard — ask for it plain.

items.ja: サーモンカルパッチョ
items.en: Salmon carpaccio (à la carte portion)
items.note: Larger version of the quick-menu dish. Raw fish; dressing undocumented.

items.en: Cheese board
items.note: Dairy. Cheese boards are served with crackers or bread — ask for it without.

items.en: Fresh (unfried) Vietnamese-style spring rolls
items.note: The wrapper for 生春巻き is rice paper, not wheat — genuinely different from a fried 春巻き. But the filling normally contains prawn and the dipping sauce is either hoisin (wheat) or nuoc cham (fish sauce), so this is 'ask', not 'gf', and not vegan as served.

items.ja: ムール貝の白ワイン蒸し
items.en: Mussels steamed in white wine
items.note: Shellfish. Steamed in wine, garlic and butter — no wheat in the classic recipe, but the bread comes with it and no ingredient list is published.

items.ja: フィッシュアンドチップス
items.en: Fish and chips
items.note: Beer batter — wheat twice over (flour and malt) — and the chips share that fryer.

items.ja: ナチョス〜贅沢トッピング〜
items.en: Nachos loaded with avocado, chilli beans, sour cream and jalapeño
items.note: Sour cream and usually melted cheese — not vegan. Corn tortilla chips carry no wheat as a rule, but Japanese-market brands often blend in wheat flour and the fryer is shared; ask.

items.en: Chips / french fries
items.note: Potato itself is wheat-free, but this kitchen fries panko-breaded salmon, karaage and beer-battered fish — a shared fryer means shared gluten.

items.en: Caprese — tomato and mozzarella
items.note: Fresh cheese. Tomato, cheese, oil and basil carry no wheat, but no allergen line is published.

items.ja: ファーマーズバーニャカウダ
items.en: Farmer's bagna cauda — raw vegetables with warm anchovy-garlic dip
items.note: Anchovy and dairy in the dip — not vegan. Bagna cauda normally has no wheat; unverified here.

items.ja: 炙りマグロのニース風サラダ
items.en: Seared tuna niçoise salad
items.note: Tuna and egg. Dressing undocumented; a 'seared' Japanese preparation often means a soy marinade.

items.en: House special salad
items.note: Contents not published. Ask what is in it and what the dressing is — that is where the wheat and the animal products live in a Japanese salad.

items.en: Italian salad
items.note: Contents not published; likely cheese and croutons, both of which would change the answer.

items.en: Four-cheese pizza
items.note: Wheat dough and dairy.

items.ja: ベーコンとほうれん草のピザ
items.en: Bacon and spinach pizza
items.note: Wheat dough, pork, dairy.

items.ja: マルゲリータ ピザ
items.en: Margherita pizza
items.note: Wheat dough and mozzarella.

items.en: Seafood pizza
items.note: Wheat dough, seafood, cheese.

items.ja: ベーコンとナスのトマトソース
items.romaji: bacon to nasu no tomato sauce
items.en: Bacon and aubergine pasta in tomato sauce
items.note: Wheat pasta and pork.

items.ja: タリアテッレうにクリームソース
items.en: Tagliatelle in sea-urchin cream sauce
items.note: Wheat pasta, sea urchin, cream.

items.ja: 渡り蟹のトマトクリームソースリングイネ
items.romaji: watarigani no tomato cream sauce linguine
items.en: Linguine with blue swimmer crab in tomato cream sauce
items.note: Wheat pasta, crab, cream.

items.en: Lasagne
items.note: Pasta sheets, béchamel (wheat roux) and meat ragù.

items.ja: ベトナム風レモングラス チキングリル
items.en: Vietnamese-style grilled lemongrass chicken
items.note: Chicken. Vietnamese lemongrass marinades use fish sauce and often soy or oyster sauce — ask, and note fish sauce also rules out vegan.

items.ja: スペシャル肉と野菜のコンボ
items.romaji: special niku to yasai no combo
items.en: Special meat-and-vegetable combination plate
items.note: Contents not published. Mixed grills here carry at least one soy-glazed element — ask item by item.

items.en: Beef tongue with scallion and salt
items.note: Beef. A 塩 (salt) preparation is the better bet in a soy-heavy kitchen — negishio sauce is scallion, sesame oil, salt and lemon — but many versions add a splash of soy, and no ingredient line is published.

items.en: Beef steak
items.note: Beef. In a Japanese izakaya the steak sauce is normally soy-based; ask for it plain with salt.

items.ja: ハワイスタイルプープスペアリブ
items.en: Hawaiian-style pupu spare ribs
items.note: Hawaiian rib glazes are built on shoyu and often hoisin — wheat.

items.ja: 豚肉のタンドール焼き
items.en: Tandoor-baked pork
items.note: Pork in a yoghurt-and-spice marinade — dairy. Tandoori marinades are usually wheat-free, but this one is undocumented and the oven may be shared with naan.

items.ja: ローズマリーローストチキン
items.en: Rosemary roast chicken
items.note: Chicken. Herb-roasted meat is often free of wheat, but the pan jus is unstated.

items.ja: アスパラチキンチーズ
items.en: Chicken with asparagus and cheese
items.note: Chicken and dairy; preparation unstated — if it is rolled and breaded it is wheat, so ask.

items.ja: 自家製 柔らか本格ローストビーフ
items.en: House-made tender roast beef
items.note: The beef itself is just beef, but Japanese roast-beef sauce is a soy-and-onion gravy as standard — wheat. Ask whether it can be served with only salt and horseradish.

items.ja: ソーセージ盛り合わせ
items.en: Assorted sausages
items.note: Pork. Sausage binders often include wheat rusk or starch, and mustard aside the accompaniments are unstated.

items.en: Churrasco of lean beef — the house speciality, seared to concentrate the juices and carved at the table
items.note: Beef. Brazilian churrasco is traditionally seasoned with nothing but coarse salt, which would make it one of the safest things on this menu — but this kitchen publishes no seasoning statement and Japanese churrasco houses commonly brush a garlic-soy marinade on. Ask specifically whether the rub is salt only.

items.ja: レモンチェッロのティラミス
items.en: Limoncello tiramisu
items.note: Savoiardi sponge fingers are wheat; mascarpone and egg.

items.ja: フォンダンショコラ バニラアイスクリーム添え
items.romaji: fondant chocolat vanilla ice cream zoe
items.en: Chocolate fondant with vanilla ice cream
items.note: Cake flour, butter, egg, dairy ice cream.

items.ja: サントリープレミアムモルツ
items.en: Suntory The Premium Malt's beer
items.note: Barley malt — the name says so. Never gluten-free.

items.en: Shandy gaff — beer with ginger ale
items.note: Half beer, so barley malt.

items.en: Panaché — beer with lemonade
items.note: Half beer, so barley malt.

items.en: Red eye — beer with tomato juice
items.note: Half beer, so barley malt.

items.en: House wine by the glass, red or white; bottles from ¥2,750
items.note: Grape wine carries no gluten grain, but wines are commonly fined with isinglass, gelatin, casein or egg white and no producer is named.

items.ja: 焼酎（ロック/水割り/ソーダ割り/お湯割り）
items.en: Shochu, on the rocks or cut with water, soda or hot water
items.note: The shop's own all-you-can-drink list names its shochu as 焼酎（甲類麦） — barley-based multiple-distilled shochu. 麦 is barley, a gluten grain, so the house shochu is not gluten-free. If you need a non-barley base you must ask for a specific bottle.

items.ja: チューハイ（ウーロンハイ／緑茶ハイ）
items.en: Shochu highball with oolong or green tea
items.note: The tea itself is a leaf infusion with no barley, but the house shochu base is 甲類麦 — barley.

items.ja: サワー（レモン／オレンジ／グレープフルーツ／ピーチ／カルピス）
items.en: Sours — lemon, orange, grapefruit, peach or Calpis
items.note: Same barley-shochu base. The Calpis version is also a dairy drink, so not vegan.

items.en: Cocktails — cassis, peach, lychee, gin and vodka bases with a long list of mixers
items.note: Gin and vodka can be grain-distilled; liqueurs vary. Ask for the base spirit if it matters. Some fruit liqueurs and creams also carry dairy.

items.en: Soft drinks — oolong tea, green tea, orange, grapefruit, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, tonic water, pineapple, cranberry
items.note: From ¥550. Note that the two teas offered are oolong and green — leaf teas with no barley in them, unlike 麦茶.

items.en: Two-hour all-you-can-drink — highballs, draught beer, wine, umeshu, shochu, sours, gin/vodka/liqueur cocktails and soft drinks; +¥550 per extra 30 min
items.note: The published contents include 生ビール, ビームハイボール (bourbon — a grain whiskey) and 焼酎（甲類麦）, all gluten grains. A coeliac on this plan is limited to the soft drinks and possibly the wine.

items.ja: 【本格シュラスコ6種含む全11品】2時間飲み放題付きコース
items.en: Party course — 11-12 dishes including six kinds of churrasco, with two hours of all-you-can-drink
items.note: Per person, 2–80 people. Course contents are not itemised; the standing menu they are drawn from includes pizza, pasta and fried items, so assume wheat is on the table.

items.ja: 【肉寿司4種＆ステーキ4種含む全14品】2時間飲み放題付きコース
items.en: The shop's No.1 course — 14 dishes including four kinds of meat sushi and four steaks, with two hours of all-you-can-drink
items.note: Per person, 2–90 people. 肉寿司 (seared meat over sushi rice) is brushed with a soy-based tare as standard.

items.ja: 【シュラスコ6種&肉寿司＆ピザ含む全19品】2時間飲み放題付きコース
items.en: 18-19 dishes including six churrascos, meat sushi (all-you-can-eat) and pizza, with two hours of all-you-can-drink
items.note: Per person, 2–80 people. Includes pizza — wheat dough.

items.ja: 生ビールなしコース【全10品＋2時間飲み放題付】
items.en: Ten-dish course with two hours of all-you-can-drink, draught beer excluded
items.note: Per person, 2–80 people. 'No draught beer' is a price choice, not an allergen one — the drink plan still includes barley shochu and bourbon highballs.

items.ja: ちょい贅沢スタンダードコース【3品＋90分飲み放題付】
items.en: Three-dish course with 90 minutes of all-you-can-drink, draught beer excluded
items.note: Per person, from two people. Contents not itemised.

items.ja: 【アラカルト】2時間単品飲み放題
items.romaji: a la carte nijikan tanpin nomihodai
items.en: Two hours of all-you-can-drink with food ordered à la carte — HotPepper-exclusive plan; two food items per person required
items.note: 2–90 people. Drink-only plan; the same barley shochu and beer apply.

tokyo_nikuudon_nikumeshi_jinza.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from the shop's own Shibuya-branch menu sheet published on udon-jinza.com, file-dated 2025-10-31. Numbers in the item notes are the ticket-machine button numbers printed on that sheet ('メニュー表の番号は券売機の番号と対応しています'). Sizes: 中盛 1.5 balls +¥70, 大盛 2 balls +¥140.

items.en: Plain kake udon — noodles in hot dashi (also served cold)
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon
items.note: Button 11 hot / 21 cold. Udon is wheat: the shop states it mills-to-order flour from Yoshihara Shokuryo in Kagawa and makes the noodles in-store every morning. The dashi is built on 煮干 (dried sardine) plus Maruo Jozosho soy sauce from Kagawa — so it is neither vegan nor wheat-free, and the same だし醤油 sits on the table.

items.en: Udon with tempura — one chikuwa fritter and two chicken fritters
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon

items.en: Chilled udon on a bamboo tray with dipping tsuyu
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon
items.note: Button 23, cold only. Wheat noodles; the tsuyu is the same soy-sauce-and-niboshi dashi.

items.en: Bukkake udon — noodles with concentrated dashi poured over, ginger and scallion
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon

items.en: 'Moon-viewing mountain' soy udon — raw egg yolk and grated yamaimo over the noodles, dressed with soy
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon

items.en: Kitsune udon — a sheet of sweet-simmered fried tofu on the noodles
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon

items.en: Udon with one chikuwa fritter and one egg fritter
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon
items.note: Button 17 hot / 27 cold. Chikuwa is a wheat-bound fish cake, the batter is wheat, and there is egg.

items.en: Udon with spicy pollock roe and butter
items.section: さぬきうどん Sanuki udon
items.note: Button 18, hot only. Wheat noodles; mentaiko is cured fish roe (usually in a soy/mirin marinade) and butter is dairy.

items.en: 'Special' meat udon — pork plus three chicken tempura
items.note: Button 31 hot / 41 cold. Wheat noodles, wheat-battered chicken, soy-simmered pork.

items.en: Meat kake udon — simmered sliced pork over noodles in dashi
items.note: Button 32 hot / 42 cold. The pork is simmered in soy and sugar; the dashi is soy and dried sardine.

items.en: Meat-and-egg bukkake udon with spicy chilli oil
items.note: Button 33 hot / 43 cold. 'ピリ辛ラー油' — chilli oil version. Wheat noodles, soy-simmered pork, raw egg.

items.en: Chicken-tempura udon with raw egg and grated yamaimo, soy-dressed
items.note: Button 34 hot / 44 cold. Wheat batter and wheat noodles, plus egg.

items.en: Meat-and-raw-egg udon dressed with soy sauce
items.note: Button 35 hot / 45 cold. Soy sauce poured directly on; wheat.

items.en: Meat bukkake udon with grated daikon
items.note: Button 36 hot / 46 cold. Wheat noodles, soy-simmered pork, soy-based bukkake dashi.

items.en: 'Super special' — double pork and four chicken tempura
items.note: Button 37 hot / 47 cold. The largest bowl on the sheet. Wheat throughout.

items.en: Curry udon — a Shibuya-branch-only collaboration with the APA president's curry
items.section: カレーうどん Curry udon
items.note: Button 51. Printed 渋谷店限定 アパ社長カレーコラボメニュー — only at this branch. Japanese curry roux is thickened with wheat flour as standard, and the noodles are wheat.

items.ja: 手仕込みチキン南蛮カレー
items.en: Hand-prepared chicken nanban curry — battered fried chicken in sweet vinegar sauce with tartare, over curry
items.section: カレーうどん Curry udon
items.note: Button 52. Chicken nanban is battered and fried then dipped in a soy-and-vinegar nanban sauce, with egg tartare; the curry roux is wheat-thickened.

items.en: Extra-meat curry with sliced pork
items.section: カレーうどん Curry udon
items.note: Button 53. Wheat-roux curry and soy-simmered pork.

items.en: Chicken tempura, 3 thigh pieces (side)
items.note: Button 71. Wheat batter, shared fryer.

items.en: Chikuwa fish-cake fritter, isobe-age style with green nori in the batter
items.note: Button 72. Chikuwa itself is bound with wheat starch and the batter is wheat; fish paste rules out vegan.

items.en: Vegetable tempura of the day
items.note: Button 73. Vegetable filling but the batter is wheat and the fryer is shared with chicken and fish — never gluten-free. Vegan is 'ask' because the batter usually contains egg and the oil is shared.

items.en: Tempura-fried seasoned soft egg (ajitama-ten)
items.note: Button 74. Egg, and the seasoning liquid for 味たま is soy-based; wheat batter.

items.en: Three-kind tempura plate — 2 chicken, 1 egg, 1 chikuwa
items.note: Button 75. Wheat batter throughout.

items.en: Chicken nanban on its own — fried chicken in sweet-vinegar sauce with tartare
items.note: Button 92. Wheat batter, soy-and-vinegar nanban sauce, egg tartare.

items.ja: 単品 めんたいチキン南蛮
items.en: Chicken nanban topped with spicy pollock roe
items.note: Button 93. As above plus cured fish roe.

items.ja: 自家製たれチャーシュー
items.en: House-tare char siu, 120 g pork loin
items.note: Buttons 58 (topping) and 94 (plate). 'たれ' means a soy-sauce-based braising liquid — wheat.

items.ja: フライドポテト（明太バター）
items.en: Chips with spicy-pollock-roe butter dip — weekday evenings and weekend lunchtimes only
items.note: Button 95. Marked 平日夜/土日昼 on the sheet. Potatoes are naturally wheat-free but come out of the same fryer as the tempura and chicken, and the dip is fish roe and butter.

items.en: Bowl of plain rice — Chiba-grown Koshihikari, milled fresh
items.note: Button 81. The shop's ingredient page names it as freshly-milled domestic rice (Chiba Koshihikari) with nothing added. Plain rice is the one thing on this board with no wheat in the recipe — but the counter is a wheat-noodle shop with a shared serving area, so 'ask' rather than 'gf'.

items.en: Rice with spicy pollock roe
items.note: Button 82. Fish roe, so not vegan. Mentaiko is usually cured in a soy/mirin/sake marinade, which would make it wheat — the shop publishes no ingredient line for it, so ask.

items.en: Small bowl of curry rice
items.note: Button 83. Japanese curry roux is wheat-flour thickened.

items.en: 'Taiwanese' minced-pork rice bowl with scallion
items.note: Button 84. Taiwanese-style minced pork is stewed in soy sauce — wheat.

items.ja: 自家製チャーシュー肉めし
items.en: House char siu rice bowl, 120 g pork loin with nori
items.note: Button 85. Soy-tare braised pork.

items.en: Chicken nanban rice bowl with tartare and nori
items.note: Button 86. Wheat batter, soy nanban sauce, egg tartare.

items.en: Extra pork belly topping
items.note: Button 56. Soy-simmered pork.

items.en: Extra 'Taiwanese' spiced minced pork topping
items.note: Button 57. Soy-stewed minced pork.

items.en: Chicken nanban as a topping
items.note: Button 59. Wheat batter and soy nanban sauce.

items.en: Extra scallion — Kagawa- and Tokushima-grown green onion
items.note: Button 61. The shop's ingredient page names Kagawa/Tokushima ao-negi. Raw onion; the caveat is the counter, not the ingredient.

items.en: Raw egg
items.note: Button 62. Egg — not vegan. From Tanaka Farm in Fukaya, Saitama, per the shop's ingredient page.

items.en: Hot-spring soft-poached egg
items.note: Button 63. Egg only, cooked in water — unlike 味玉 it is not soy-marinated, but the shop publishes no allergen line.

items.en: Grated daikon radish
items.note: Button 64. Plain grated radish; usually eaten with the soy-based dashi already in the bowl.

items.en: Grated mountain yam
items.note: Button 65. Grated raw yam. Often loosened with dashi in udon shops — ask, because that dashi is soy and dried sardine here.

items.en: Sweet-simmered fried tofu sheet
items.note: Button 66. Simmered in soy and sugar (wheat), and the simmering stock in a Sanuki shop is made with dried sardine.

items.en: Spicy pollock roe
items.note: Button 67. Fish roe — not vegan. Mentaiko marinades commonly contain soy sauce and sake; no ingredient line published, so ask.

items.en: Medium portion — 1.5 noodle balls (surcharge)
items.note: Marked ① on the sheet. More wheat noodles.

items.en: Large portion — 2 noodle balls (surcharge)
items.note: Marked ② on the sheet. More wheat noodles.
